title: Carpooling is really a test of luck.
titleZh: 顺风车真的有点考验运气了
body: The guy kept crunching away on spicy snacks the whole way, and the smell in the car was something else. His phone kept playing livestream battles at a ridiculously loud volume. My poor clip-on earbuds couldn't block it out. I could barely breathe, my ears were ringing, and my head was pounding. Those two hours were unbearable. #Carpooling #CouldTheWorldBeAKinderPlace
bodyZh: 大哥一路上麻辣鲜香嘎嘣嘎嘣的，车上的味道太难评了。手机还一直在放各种PK直播，特别吵声音又超大，我可怜的耳夹耳机根本抵不住。呼吸是小心翼翼的，耳膜是嗡嗡的，脑门是突突的，好难熬的两个小时。#顺风车 #世界能不能对我好一点

title: Carpooling really gave me an emo treatment today😅
titleZh: 今天打顺风车真的给我整emo了😅
body:
As soon as I got in the car, I could smell the smell of garlic. The driver also played the audio aloud of Xu Song's song at a very high volume.
While holding my breath due to the smell of garlic, I listened to the driver humming "Chengfu" and "Suyan"
The little brother sang quite enthusiastically. I wore a mask in the passenger seat and dared not breathe. My soul swayed to the melody and my nose was tortured.
Let’s just say, can you rinse your mouth before driving? Playing audio aloud music can really put people in a funny and painful situation
Throughout the entire journey, I just wanted to reach my destination quickly, and this carpooling experience was truly magical 😂
bodyZh:
刚上车一股大蒜气息扑面而来，司机小哥还超大音量外放许嵩的歌
一边被蒜味熏得屏住呼吸，一边听着司机哼唱《城府》《素颜》
小哥唱得还挺投入，我在副驾戴着口罩大气不敢喘，灵魂跟着旋律摇摆，鼻子饱受摧残
咱就是说，能不能开车前漱漱口啊！外放音乐真的会让人陷入又好笑又煎熬的境地
全程只想快点抵达目的地，这趟顺风车体验直接封神😂

title: Why am I still not brave enough?
titleZh: 为什么我还是不够勇敢
body:
I did some carpooling when I got home, and I was lucky enough to get it with another person. The driver picked me up after picking me up. Before he got in the car, there was only low-pitched car music, but 10 minutes later this person came with his arrogant and loud playing audio aloud and ultra-high decibel game background sound. The excitement was as if he was about to compete in the e-sports circle as a seed player after getting off the car.
	
I felt uncomfortable, and I had been brewing in my mind for a long time, "Hello, your voice is too loud, could you please lower it?" "Hello, I want to take a break, could you please turn down the volume on your phone?", but I still didn't dare to say it. My mind flashed through countless scenes of sisters who I saw in other posts bravely speaking out, but at the same time, "He looks very strong, will he beat me if he is irritable?" He just said "The driver's address is not far from my home. Will he retaliate against me?" "The driver didn't speak and the driver is also a man. Will he not care or even stand with him?" "The principle of compromise for the happy should be forgotten." These thoughts came up one by one and quickly overwhelmed me. I immediately knocked down the courage I gained from my sisters. I was so cowardly that I didn't even say such a simple and reasonable request until he got off the car.
	
I hate myself for being so weak, but is that my problem? This society makes people afraid to speak out, even if the voice is reasonable and correct. Asking "Can you please lower your voice?" is obviously a common thing and does not require courage to describe it, but before I said it, I thought of many negative cases and social news, and I was scared.
	
I want to be stronger. I can't stand myself like this. On the high-speed train home, I bravely fought with the boy next to me for the right to use the middle armrest. On the subway, I dared to spread my legs and let the man next door pull his legs back. I couldn't do this before. Before, I would only feel uncomfortable and uncomfortable, and then swallow it silently and be forced to accept it. But now I don't want to give up my normal rights and space.
	
So why I "didn't dare" this time, a large part of the reason was the size of the space. Before, it was in public places with many people, such as subways and high-speed trains. I felt that the other party would not mess around in such places. Even if he did, I could at least ask for help (although there were a lot of bad things happening in such places, I would have the most basic psychological sense of security). But at that time, it was only me, him and the driver, two people of the opposite sex, so I backed down.
	
what to do? I don’t know what else I can ask of this society. Maybe many people think this is nothing. Why are you so cowardly? It can be solved with just one sentence. It’s you who think so badly of others. How can you be so smart about it? But obviously I have always believed that there are more kind people in the world. In fact, I believe so now, but I did not do it at the time. I can only say to myself: Be stronger.
Be stronger.
	
# Playing audio aloud #essay #female thinking
bodyZh:
回家的时候打了个顺风车，运气好和另一个人拼到了，司机接完我之后去接他，在他上车之前车内只有小声的车载音乐，但10min之后此人带着他牛气哄哄大声外放的超高分贝游戏背景音来了，热闹程度仿佛下了这辆车就要作为种子选手逐鹿电竞圈大杀四方。
	
我觉得不适，心里酝酿了好久的“你好，你的声音太大了能不能小一点”“你好，我想休息一会，能不能把你的手机声音调小一点”，但我还是没敢说出口，我脑子里闪过无数在其他帖子看到的姐妹们勇敢发声的样子，但在同一时间闪过“他看起来体型非常壮如果他很易怒会不会揍我”“他刚刚说出口的住址离我家不远他会不会报复我”“司机也没开口说话且司机也是男的会不会不care甚至和他站在一起”“幸福者退让原则要不还是算了吧”，这些念头一个一个冒出来，迅速把我淹没，把我在姐妹们那里收获的一点勇气立马打倒了，我好怂，直到他下车我都没把如此简单合理的诉求说出口。
	
我恨我自己太弱了，但这是我的问题吗？这个社会让人不敢发出声音，即便这个声音是合理的、正确的。提出“可以小声一点吗”明明是一件再平常不过根本不需要用勇气来形容的事情，但出口之前我想到好多反面案例，想到好多社会新闻，我害怕了。
	
我想变得更强一点，我受不了这样的自己，明明在回家的高铁上我和邻座的男生勇敢地争夺了中间那条扶手的使用权，明明在地铁上我已经敢抻开腿让隔壁的男人把大张的腿收回去，这些放在以前我是做不到的，之前我只会觉得不适难受，然后默默咽下被迫接受，但现在我不想再让渡正常的权利和空间。
	
那为什么这次我“不敢”了，很大一部分原因来自空间的大小，之前都是地铁高铁这种人多的公共场合，我心里觉得对方不会在这种场合乱来，即便会我起码也能求救（虽说在这种场合发生的破事也不少但我心理上会有最基本的安全感），但当时只有我加上他和司机两名异性，所以我退缩了。
	
怎么办？我不知道我还能怎么要求这个社会，可能很多人觉得这简直不是事，你咋这么怂明明一句话就解决了，是你把别人想的太坏了你怎么这么能脑补。但明明我一直相信世界上善良的人更多的，其实现在我也如此相信，但当时的我的确没有做到。我只能对自己说：再强壮一点吧。
再强壮一点吧。
	
#大声外放 #随笔 #女性思考

title: Gaode carpooling speechless incident
titleZh: 高德顺风车大无语事件
body:
I'm really speechless. I took a high-definition private carpooling today. As soon as I got in the car, the driver's family members were sitting in the passenger seat, and a movie was playing loudly in the car.
I remained silent the whole time and didn't offer a single comment.
Later, the driver turned off the movie and switched to playing music, and my companions and I chatted at normal volume. There were other shared ride passengers in the car, and they didn't feel noisy.
As a result, the driver said directly: "We will talk about this beauty if we can go back." 😤
I feel a little offended. If you tell me please keep your voice down, I can totally understand.
But let us go back and talk about it directly, which means that we are not allowed to talk in the car, which sounds very uncomfortable.
I replied directly: You were playing a movie when you got in the car, and I didn’t say anything. After speaking, the driver turned off the music himself.
Carpooling is a carpooling trip, not a library. You can understand each other, but you can't have double standards. You are only allowed to make noise, and passengers are prohibited from talking normally.
I have submitted a complaint on the platform and hope that no one will encounter this situation when traveling.
Have you ever encountered this kind of double standard situation when taking carpooling?
#driver #taxicomment #高德carpooling #行 Lightning Protection
bodyZh:
真的有点无语，今天坐高德私人顺风车，一上车副驾就坐着司机的家属，车里大声放电影。
我全程没吭声，没有提一句意见。
后来司机关掉电影改成放音乐，我和同行的人就正常音量聊天，车上还有别的拼车乘客，人家也没觉得吵。
结果司机直接来一句：“美女能不能回去再说”。😤
我就有点觉得被冒犯了，如果好好跟我说麻烦小声一点，我完全可以理解。
但直接让我们回去再说，意思就是车上不允许我们交谈，这个话听着特别让人不舒服。
我当时直接回了：上车你就在放电影，我也什么都没说。说完之后司机自己把音乐关掉了。
顺风车是合乘出行，又不是图书馆，可以互相体谅，但不能搞双重标准，只允许自己制造噪音，禁止乘客正常说话。
已经在平台提交投诉，希望大家出行都不要遇到这种情况。
你们坐顺风车遇到过这种双标情况吗？
#司机 #打车吐槽 #高德顺风车 #出行避雷

title: It was the first time that carpooling was so frustrating, and it opened my eyes.
titleZh: 第一次顺风车这么憋屈，开了眼了
body:
After getting in the car, I held a work conference call with my colleagues. Wearing headphones throughout the whole process, we communicated calmly, without any noise or playing audio aloud.
After only ten or twenty minutes of playing, the driver suddenly became aggressive and asked me to lower my voice, and I also lowered the volume.
As a result, the whole process only lasted half an hour, and he immediately started to get angry and throw his face:
"Be quiet in the car, go to the service area to make calls, and consider other people's feelings."
I actually laughed.
It's just him, his wife and kids in the car. It's fine for him to play music all the way, but it's not okay for me to wear headphones and talk normally?
What, your car is an exclusive VIP seat in the high-speed rail silent carriage?
Ride-hailing is here to serve passengers, not to be a rule-maker or emotional trainer for me.
Doing work in the car is a productive time for working people. I basically have no tolerance for this. I seriously doubt that I have never been to work. It is recommended not to ride-hailing. It is better to open a silent meditation cabin.
I sincerely recommend that everyone stay away from this kind of extremely emotionally unstable middle-aged male driver.
He gets angry easily, gets angry at others for no reason, and plays double standards.
If we weren't on an elevated highway and there were children in the car, I really would have wanted to argue the case right there and then.
I didn't say a few harsh words from beginning to end, but he was the first to explode and was completely convinced.
When you spend money to ride in a car, you have to look at the driver’s face and work carefully.
With this kind of service attitude and quality, we really don’t want to go out and cause trouble to passengers.
Backhand a complaint.
#driver #carpoolingdriver #malecarpoolingmaster #carpooling #Hangzhoucarpooling
bodyZh:
上车后跟同事开工作电话会议，全程戴耳机，情绪平稳沟通，没有喧哗没有外放。
也就打了十几二十分钟，司机突然气势汹汹让我声音小点，我也配合调低了音量。
结果全程加起来也就半小时，直接开始发飙甩脸子：
“车里要安静，要打电话去服务区打，也要考虑别人感受。”
我真的笑了。
车里就他跟他老婆孩子，他自己一路放音乐完全没问题，我戴耳机正常通话就不行？
怎么，你这车是高铁静音车厢专属VIP位啊？
网约车是服务乘客的，不是来给我当规矩制定者、情绪管教员的。
在车上处理工作是打工人的高效时间，这点基本包容心都没有，严重怀疑没上过班，建议别开网约车了，适合去开静音冥想舱。
真心建议大家远离这种情绪极不稳定的中年男司机。
自己一点就燃，莫名其妙冲人发火，双标玩得一套一套的。
要不是在高架上，车里还有小孩，真的想当场理论到底。
从头到尾我没说几句重话，他倒先炸了，服得彻彻底底。
花钱坐车还得看司机脸色、小心翼翼憋工作，
这服务态度和素质，真的别出来跑单祸害乘客了。
反手一个投诉。
#司机 #顺风车司机 #男顺风车主 #顺风车 #杭州顺风车

Yesterday, I was thinking of placing a order when I went home, and I picked up a male passenger who is 90% of the people on my way home.
Really bad experience
First, this male passenger slammed the car door so hard. I have never been hit so hard in my whole life. I couldn’t help but turn around and tell him, don’t close the door so hard when you get off the car.
The second one really stinks. Even the fragrance couldn't cover up the smell. As a driver, I almost got carsick due to the smell, so I had no choice but to keep three windows open the whole time. After the passengers got off the bus, I drove around for half a circle to catch my breath.
Third, he has been playing Tik Tok so loudly that my music can’t cover up the sound of Tik Tok.
I really won’t poop anymore, and I won’t be curious anymore.

title: Should the driver also shout "Ten days of hard work to make us bigger and stronger"?
titleZh: 司机也要喊“十个勤天做大做强”吗？
body:
#十千天 #妾屋人 #禾青久久 #何浩南 #何浩南青道 # Northeast人 #同干
After the concert, we took a taxi. The driver was from Heilongjiang. He was very interesting. He started chatting with us. He said he had forgotten that there was a concert today, so he took the order from both of us. Originally, he didn’t plan to take the order today and wanted to come directly to the door to solicit customers (very lucky, he happened to be hit by accident). My brother took the order. I thought I couldn’t get a taxi, but as soon as it came out, I got one. My sister really saved us!) Originally, there were only two people in the car, my sister and I. But seeing that it was raining and windy outside, it was too dangerous, so I thought about asking two more people to come up and share with us! ride, I shouted for a long time, but no one wanted to come up to the shared ride. I said, brother, open the window and let me shout. Just outside the window, there were two people walking messily in the wind. I quickly shouted, "He, get on the bus! Shared ride! Get on!" The two of them didn't hesitate at all, as if they saw a savior, they came up immediately. Then the four of us started chatting with our brother. He asked us whose concert it was today. We said it was He Haonan, the oldest member of the Ten Qintians... Then he said that he knew the Ten Qintians, but didn’t know who was in them. We said that you just know the Ten Qintians! Then we started to teach our brother to shout slogans, which made us happy! My Northeastern accent is so fun! The four of us were very excited and high-spirited along the way. We were chattering to my brother about the ten days of hard work. The Hehe people were just going around and enjoying the ten days of work. We were noisy to my brother and asked us to keep our voices down. His ears couldn’t bear it 🤣It’s so fun, special thanks to brother for saving the four of us! Otherwise we would be soaked outside!

#十个勤天 #禾伙人 #禾勤久久 #何浩楠 #何浩楠青岛 #东北人#同担

title: Complaints from a real carpoolingcar owner!
titleZh: 来自真顺风车车主的吐槽！
body:
I have been carpooling for ten years. When a certain D had an accident in Chengdu, he was taking people to and from get off work. Driving a gas car can really save money. At the peak, he could make 2,000 yuan a month. Now, it is almost 800 yuan in 20 days. They are all taking people to and from get off work, not professional!
1. You are taking carpooling, which is defined by the state as carpooling. I am the car owner and you are the carpooler. Our act of civil mutual assistance is not a transportation service contract! I’m not ride-hailing either!
2. The money you pay is only about half of taking a taxi during the morning and evening peak hours. This is called a reasonable sharing of toll costs. It’s not a service fee, so you won’t get much money!
3. Exclusive ride is not the same as chartering a car. I can have relatives and friends in the car, and I will make a note clearly. If you want to ride alone at the carpooling price, you may not always be able to do so!
4. There is no carpooling service, no luggage is carried, and the trunk is opened and closed by yourself. My obligation is to safely transport you from the starting point to the destination without violating the platform rules. I have the final say in route planning!
5. Those orders of 4 kilometers, 3 people, and 5 yuan, please don’t invite me. I really don’t like it. Even if you refuse, you still want to invite me. Do you think that’s US dollars? Either go find a bus that costs two yuan, or read some books if you can't find one!
6. For orders in the city, I am commuting to and from get off work. If you don’t get more than 90% of the orders, don’t invite me. I’m too lazy to pick you up. Under normal circumstances, I only accept more than 95% of the orders!
7. Don’t make excessive demands. Please take a ride-hailing taxi between the two locations. There is no rule of entering the community or the basement. Please be polite and communicate in case of special weather!
8. Life and work are already very tiring, so don’t make me angry in my car. If you can’t bear it, don’t curse, but I will fight back no matter how angry you are. Anyway, if you don’t violate several major principles, the platform can’t handle me!
9. Don’t think that whoever takes the order will definitely come to pick you up. Everyone has unexpected circumstances that change the itinerary. I often get dropped after running to the starting point. Not only do I have to go home directly, but there are many uncertain factors if I am not an operating vehicle.
10. I don’t have to pay for the ride around the city. If other highways are not necessary, please bear the cost yourself (in the city). After all, if you only pay a few yuan for tolls for 20 yuan or so, you won’t have to worry about it!
11. You must listen to music. If you want to sleep, I can turn it down appropriately, but please be polite. This is not a matter of course. Of course, I will also pause when you call. If I forget, you can remind me!
12. If you have been with the car owner for a long time, you can add a V after the end to make it easier to book a car. This kind of situation is generally more secure after all! However, be sure not to trade offline, otherwise it will be too late to cry after the accident!
13. The price varies depending on the number of people! Don’t think that the exclusive ride you ordered can only accommodate a few people, so I’ll have to ask you to cancel and wait where you are. I’d rather have an empty ride than take you! There is a saying that you can lose both ways, but you can't win alone!
14. Please note your luggage in advance. The car owner’s trunk may not be empty, otherwise you may not be able to get in even when he arrives!
15. If you are bringing a cat or a dog, be sure to note that no matter whether your dog sheds or not, it can get into your bed but it can never get into my car. Don’t wait until it’s close, then I’ll have to let you crawl alone!
bodyZh:
顺风车十年，某D成都出事那会儿就上下班带人了，开油车是真的能节省开支，最高峰一个月可以做两千，现在的话差不多20天八百。都是上下班带人，非职业！
1、你是坐顺风车，国家定义是私人小客车合乘，我是车主，你是合乘人，我们是民事互助行为，不是运输服务合同！我也不是网约车！
2、你给的钱在早晚高峰的时候只有打车的一半左右，这个叫合理分摊通行成本，不是啥服务费，没得几个钱！
3、独享也并不等同于包车，我车内可以有亲友，我会备注清楚的，想用顺风车的价一个人坐车可能不是每次都能遇到！
4、顺风车没有服务，不提行李，后备箱自己按开关。我的义务就是不违反平台规则的情况安全把你从起点送到终点，线路规划我说了算！
5、那些4公里，3个人，5块钱的订单，拜托你不要邀请了，真看不上，拒绝了都还要一直邀请，你那是美元吗？要么自己去找两块钱的公交车，找不到的去读点儿书！
6、市内订单，我是上下班的，没得90%以上也就别邀请了，懒得来接你，一般情况下都只接95%以上顺路的！
7、不要提过分的要求，两个地点上下的请你打网约车出租车，没得进小区进地下室的规矩，特殊天气请客气点儿沟通！
8、生活、上班已经很累了，所以在我车上不要给我气受，受不了一点儿，不骂人，但是你怎么给我气受我就怎么怼回来，反正几大原则不违反，平台也处理不了我！
9、别觉得谁接单了就一定会来接你，谁都有意外情况改变行程，我还经常跑到起点以后被放鸽子了的，还不是只有直接回家了，不是运营车就会有很多不确定的因素。
10、走绕城我有etc不给钱，如果其他高速是非必须的，请自行承担费用（市内），毕竟20来块钱再给个几块钱过路费就没得搞了！
11、音乐肯定是要听的，你要睡觉我可以适当关小，但是请客气一点儿，这个不是理所应当的。当然你打电话的时候我也会暂停一下，如果我忘记了可以提醒一下我！
12、长期和车主一条线的，可以结束后加个V，方便约车，这种一般会毕竟有保障一些！但是，一定不要线下交易，不然事故以后哭都来不及！
13、人数不一样，价格也有差距！别觉得下的独享，上来几个人都可以，那我就只有让你取消原地等着，我宁愿空车也不会拉你的！有句话叫做可以双输，但是不能独赢！
14、有行李提前备注，车主的后备箱不一定是空着的，不然有可能他到了你也上不去！
15、带阿猫阿狗的一定要备注，不管你的狗儿子掉不掉毛，它可以上你的床但是绝对不能上我的车，不要跑拢了才说，那就只有让你各人爬！

title: I’m annoyed by people talking loudly on the phone on shared rides

Today I told her to hang up quickly. She also said that the sound was heard when she opened the window. Sister, why don't you stick your head out. You actually have the nerve to say that you are like this every day. That's because you were lucky enough to have a good temper before. I'm sorry for you, I can't bear it. You know how to keep your voice down on the high-speed rail, but not on shared rides. If you have the ability, use the premium ride service. title: Is sharing a ride with others and talking on the phone all the time in the car considered unqualified?
titleZh: 和别人拼车，在车里一直打电话，算没素质吗
body:
I took a shared ride after get off work, a shared ride for three people.
.
One of them started making work calls one after another as soon as he got in the car. Throughout the car, with the air conditioner on and the windows closed, her voice was in my ears, talking endlessly. You are quite tired after working all day. If you want to work overtime, do you have to work overtime at work, or go home alone in a car? My head feels so swollen😣
.
Sometimes I see the noisy children on the train and the plane, which makes the passengers disgusted. The parents say, the children are young, can't you be considerate? There are no videos of children talking in your home. To be honest, some regulations in public places do not require much explanation. It is clear at a glance whether you have considered others in public places.
.
If a child just barks accidentally or hits the back of a chair without knowing the severity, who will say anything. If the person on the shared ride car just made a phone call to briefly explain something, I would be considerate. But if you can’t understand public places and feel that the public places you are in are private spaces, it’s almost meaningless.
.
Want to hear what everyone thinks. On the way to get off work, I was a little annoyed 😡
.
# Commute to get off work carpooling #carpoolingexperience sharing #COMmuting to get off work @ Potato Captain
bodyZh:
下班打了一辆拼车，三个人的拼车。
.
其中一个人，上车没一会儿就开始一个个工作电话往外打。整个车里，开着空调，关着车窗，她的声音就一直在耳边，说个没完没了。上了一天班，都挺累的，你想加班，是不是在单位加，或者单独一辆车回家。脑袋好涨😣
.
有时刷到火车上飞机上，熊孩子吵吵闹闹引来乘客反感，家长一副，孩子小，不能体谅吗，你家没孩子言辞的视频。讲真，公共场合的一些规范，不需要太多解释，你考没考虑公共场合里的别人，一目了然。
.
如果孩子只是偶然叫一下，或者不知轻重的锤一下椅背，谁会说什么。如果现在车上拼车的这个人，只是打一个电话简单交代个事情，都能体谅。但搞不清公共场合，觉得自己在的公共场合是私人空间，是不就差点意思了。
.
想听听大家怎么看。下班路上，有点恼火😡
.

title: It's hard to describe what I encountered when I met a female carpooling driver. . .
titleZh: 遇女性顺风车司机 一言难尽。。。
body:
1/2
It's hard to describe what I encountered when I met a female carpooling driver. . .
For several months in a row, I used carpooling as a cheap version of taking a taxi. I spent an average of more than 1,000 on carpooling every month, which allowed me to meet all kinds of drivers. Most of them work full-time. Some may not admit it, but it can be seen from the number of orders they receive. Some of them were middle-aged and unemployed, driving around in a top-of-the-line Krypton 001 that they bought for more than 400,000 yuan at the time. There were also some who failed in business and became dishonest people who could not do anything else. They borrowed tens of thousands from someone to buy a second-hand tram and run it. Some of them came to my house early in the morning in order to receive my "long-distance order" of less than 100 kilometers, and stayed in the car overnight waiting for me to get up and set off. Everyone was working hard to survive. . . Today's driver is an older lady. This is the first time I have met a female driver. Her tone is gentle. She was delayed for a few minutes on the way here because she took the wrong route. She even called me to apologize. As soon as I got in the car, I smelled a strong smell of medicine. There were bottles and cans of colorful medicine in the boxes on the armrest box. Then I saw the child sitting in front of the passenger seat. On such a hot day, the air conditioning temperature in the car was not low, but the child was wrapped in a thick quilt. The eldest sister drove very seriously, her hands never left the steering wheel, and her eyes were always staring ahead. Perhaps she was not very skilled. She always looked several times at each intersection before daring to slowly merge onto the main road. The usually one-and-a-half-hour journey took almost two hours to arrive. Maybe it was the only thing she could find that could take care of her children. It's a job that can make money again. Thinking of this, my nose felt sore. God gave me a heart to pity all living beings, but did not give me the ability to save all living beings. But then I thought about it, what qualifications do I have to pity others, my own life is also a piece of cake.
08-07

遇女性顺风车司机 一言难尽。。。
连续几个月把顺风车当做廉价版本的打车，平均每个月在顺风车上都花费1000多，这让我遇到了形形色色的司机。 他们大多都是全职，或许有些人并不承认，但从接单数量是能看得出来的。 他们当中有中年失业，开着当时40多万买的顶配极氪001跑，也有生意失败成了失信人员，做不了别的，找人借了几万，买个二手电车在跑；有人为了接到我这个不到一百公里的“长途订单”，提前一天的凌晨就到我家附近，在车里过夜等我起床出发，大家都在努力的活着。。。 今天的司机是个大姐，这是我第一次遇到女司机，语气温柔，过来的路上因为走错路耽误了几分钟，还打电话向我道歉。我一上车就闻到了很重的药味，扶手箱上的盒子里瓶瓶罐罐的装着五彩斑斓的药，紧接着就看到了副驾驶前坐着的小孩，在这样的大热天里，车里的空调温度并不低，小孩却裹着厚厚的被子。 大姐开车开得很认真，双手从未离开过方向盘，眼睛也一直紧紧盯着前方，或许是不太熟练，每到路口总要张望好几眼才敢慢慢汇入主路，平时一个半小时的路程花了差不多两小时到达。 可能这是她唯一能找到的，既能照顾孩子。又能赚到钱的工作了吧。想到这里我鼻子一阵酸楚，上天给了我一颗怜悯众生的心，却没有给我拯救众生的能力，可再一想，我又有什么资格怜悯他人，自己的生活不也是一地鸡毛。

title: I got carpooling and felt nauseous for a long time.
titleZh: 接了个顺风车，恶心了好久
body:
I got carpooling and felt nauseous for a long time.
🚗carpooling lightning protection! 98% of the time, is it really a smooth road? Don’t be fooled by the big words! I drove back to my hometown alone and signed up for carpooling with the idea of ​​sharing some costs. I only took these two orders (⚠️emphasis: these two orders were not on the same day! I took them twice), which really made me sick😡 💡Blood and Tears Summary: The "98% smooth way" and "95% smooth way" displayed in large characters on the homepage of the app are simply not accurate! ! When accepting an order, everyone must read the fine print carefully [how long will it take to pick up and drop off passengers/how long will the detour take]! The small print is the truth, the big print is all lies! 🔍 📉First order (return): 📱App shows: 98% of the tickets are on the way 💸highway tolls: Passengers choose not to pay for highway tolls (ok, I think it’s a bit more economical). 🛣️The actual situation: In order to see him off, we took a 40-minute detour in the city! In the end, the total price was just over half of highway tolls (more than 60 yuan). It’s really not worth it to be exhausted after driving all day! 🤦‍♀️ 📉The second order (outbound, not on the same day as the first order): 📱app shows: 95% of the way (only halfway) 💸highway tolls: This time he is willing to pay for all highway tolls, but! What he meant was to take the expressway first, then get to the nearest expressway entrance to his destination and then get on the expressway (actually the highway tolls he was willing to pay were only a few dollars, but it was 40 minutes slower than taking the expressway directly from the city). 🛣️But the actual situation: Because I was not familiar with the app, I searched the place name on the map myself, but I fell into the trap of "the same name but different places"! His real destination was still 40 minutes away from the highway exit, and it was all mountainous! 🏔️ The originally 2 and a half hours of driving by myself was delayed for more than an hour, and it took me almost 4 hours to get home! collapse! For more than 70 yuan 🤯 😤 What makes me speechless the most is the attitude of the passengers: My car costs more than 20 watts, and the interior is clean with no smoke or odor. Does it fully meet the standards of Didi premium ride service? They took it for granted that they spent more than 60 to 70 yuan for a 1-2 and a half hour taxi ride, and they didn't feel any gratitude at all. They felt that everything was as it should be after they paid the money and I took the order! It’s really fast! For this small amount of money, I took a detour and wasted time. Without a heartwarming word, I logged out. Goodbye🙄
07-05
bodyZh:
接了个顺风车，恶心了好久
🚗顺风车避雷！98%顺路就是真顺路？别被大字骗了！ 一个人开车回老家，想着分担点成本就注册了顺风车。我只接了这两单（⚠️强调：这两单不是同一天！分两次接的），真的让我恶心坏了😡 💡血泪总结： app首页大字显示的“98%顺路”、“95%顺路”根本不准！！大家接单一定要仔细看小字 【接送乘客需要耽搁多久/绕路多久】！小字才是真相，大字全是忽悠！🔍 📉第一单（回程）： 📱app显示：98%顺路 💸高速费：乘客选择不愿意出高速费（行，我想着省点是一点）。 🛣️实际情况：为了送他，在城区硬生生绕路了40分钟！最后到手总价才高速费的一半多一点（60多块钱）。开了一天车累得半死，真的很不值！🤦‍♀️ 📉第二单（去程，和第一单不是同一天）： 📱app显示：95%顺路（只到半路） 💸高速费：这次他愿意全部出高速费了，但是！他的意思是先走快速路，到离他目的地最近的高速口再上高速（其实他愿意出的高速费也就几块钱，但比从城区直接上高速慢40分钟）。 🛣️而实际情况：因为不熟悉app，我自己去地图搜了地名，结果踩了“同名不同地”的坑！他真正的目的地离那个高速出口还有40分钟，而且全是山路！🏔️ 原本我自己开车2个半小时的路程，硬生生被耽搁了1个多小时，开了快4个小时才到家！崩溃！为了70多元🤯 😤最让我无语的是乘客的态度： 我的车20多W，内饰干净没烟味没异味，完全达到滴滴专车的标准了吧？他们花6、70多块钱打1-2个半小时的车都觉得理所当然，完全没有一点感激的意思，觉得付了钱，我接单，一切都是应该的！真的栓Q了！为了这点钱，绕路耽搁时间，还没有一句暖心的话，注销了，拜拜🙄

title: Didi carpooling dangerous car owner complaint‼ ️
titleZh: 滴滴顺风车危险车主投诉‼️
body:
1/8
Didi carpooling dangerous car owner complaint‼ ️
"Didi carpooling complaint!! Sisters, I will feel something is wrong before getting in the car. Never get in the car. I would rather spend more money to take a taxi instead of getting in the car. Share today's carpooling experience. Today at noon, I made an appointment with an exclusive ride carpooling (exclusive ride) departing from 12:00 to 12:15 to have dinner with friends. I think the journey takes about 1 hour and we can arrive before 13:30. The driver called me in advance and said highway The tolls asked me to pay for it, and I asked if it was half and half. The driver said it was only 10 yuan, and I said that was fine. The driver arrived downstairs at my house at 12:15, and I saw two men in the car. You can pay for the tolls yourself. The driver said you can pay 8 yuan. I asked why it was 10 yuan and I paid 8 yuan. The driver said 13 and I just got in the car and said let’s go first. When I drove to the gate of the community, I saw the driver was waiting. I saw that the route was not my normal route, and the end point was not the location I chose. I said that I should go to my place first. The driver said no, and he would send the next one first. I assumed that the two of them were together, and I asked how long it would take to get to my place, and the driver said no. It’s only 10-20 minutes, which is okay, I thought, because I saw that the next destination time was 13:09, so I thought to myself, let’s go. I heard another passenger on the bus saying that the money has been paid to you. If you are a friend, why are you charged separately? It’s obvious that you take the order privately. After walking for only a few kilometers, the driver asked me to pay for the highway tolls first. I said I would pay later. You can pay extra on the platform. The driver asked me to pay first. I insisted again. I said not to do this kind of thing in the future. If you can, pick up the tolls. If you can't, don't pick up. At least tell the passenger in advance. He said to tell me, and I said, just tell me about the highway. Did you say there was someone in the car? The driver said, "Beauty, I'll give you another chance." I didn't dare to speak, so I paid the highway tolls first. Because the experience was so bad, I took photos throughout the journey to prove that there were other people on the bus. Then at around 13:09, when I arrived at the first destination, I found that only one of them got off the bus, but I didn’t ask if the next stop was for me. When I got to the next stop, I asked how long it would take to get there, and the driver said it would only be a few minutes. We arrived at the second destination at 13:21. Did I say we were there? I was about to get off the bus, but the driver said it was not you, and then the second passenger got off. I took videos and photos to prove the time when the first passenger got off and the second passenger got off. The word limit has been exceeded. Please take a look at the screenshots for details. Thank you."
08-15
bodyZh:
1/8
滴滴顺风车危险车主投诉‼️
"滴滴顺风车投诉！！ 姐妹们以后上车前就感觉到不对劲，千万不要上车，宁愿多花点钱重新打车也不要上车 分享一下今日顺风车经历。今天中午约了独享的顺风车（独享）12点到12点15出发的顺风车去和朋友吃饭，我看车程大概1小时，13点30前可以到达。司机提前给我打电话说高速费让我出，我说可以一半一半吗，司机说也就10块钱，我说那行。 司机12点15到达我家楼下，我看到车上有两个男的，我当时就不爽了，我说我不是点的独享吗？司机说我知道你点的是独享，但是这是我两个朋友，我说不能接就别接，然后我说那高速费你们自己出吧，司机说那你出8块钱可以吧，我说为啥10块钱我出8块，司机说13。我就直接上车说先走吧。 开到小区门口我就看司机在点位置，我看那个路线不是我正常走的路线，且终点不是我选的位置，我说是先去我的地点吧。司机说不是，先送后面的。我当时默认两个人是一起的，我就说那去我那里还要多久，司机说也就多个10-20分钟，我心想也还好，因为看到车上显示到下一个目的地时间是13:09。于是我就心想那就走吧。车上有听到另外的乘客说钱已经付给你了啊。如果是朋友，怎么会单独收费呢，明显就是私下接单。 走了没有几公里，司机让我先付高速费，我说我等会会付，平台上可以点额外付费，司机让我先付，我又坚持了一遍。我说以后不要干这种事情了，能接就接不能接就别接了，至少也要提前和乘客先说，他说和我说了，我说你就只和我说了高速费我出，你有说车上有人吗？后面有个乘客说算了算了，别吵了。司机说: 美女，我再给你一次机会。语气很吓人。我不敢说话了，我就把高速费先付了。 因为体验感很不好，我全程是有拍照证明车上有其他人的。然后到了13点09左右，到了第一个目的地，我发现只有其中一人下车了，但是我没有问下一站是不是去我那里，等快到下一站目的地的时候，我说还要多久到啊，司机说就几分钟了，13点21到了第二个目的地，我说到了吗，我准备下车，司机说不是你，然后第二个乘客下车了。第一个乘客下车和第二个乘客下车我都有录视频拍照证明时间点。 超出字数限制了，详细的请姐妹们看截图吧！谢谢"
08-15

title: Using AutoNavi carpooling as a blind box, the experience is actually a bit overwhelming
titleZh: 把高德顺风车当盲盒开，这体验居然有点上头
body:
1/2
Using AutoNavi carpooling as a blind box, the experience is actually a bit overwhelming
In the past, when I used taxi-hailing apps, I just wanted to come and arrive quickly. Recently, I started using AutoNavi carpooling frequently because I was traveling across town to see friends, and suddenly I discovered that the core experience of this thing is actually a bit like opening a blind box. You never know what kind of car or personality the car owner will take. Once when I went to the next city, the person who took the order was a man driving an SUV. The trunk was filled with his fishing equipment. As soon as he got in the car, he chatted with me about the big fish he caught yesterday. Another time, it was a young female car owner who drove a small tram. The car was beautifully decorated, and the podcasts we both liked were played all the way. We drove quietly to the destination. Moreover, this "blind box" refers not only to the car owner, but also to the route. Sometimes the car owner does not follow the navigation, but will take you around some small roads that you would not notice at ordinary times and see different scenery. The most important thing is that the cost of opening this blind box is extremely low, and the price is generally only half of that of taking a taxi. Spend less money and experience different aspects of the world. Every time you send an itinerary and wait for matching, you even have a little expectation. This is probably the difference between carpooling and ordinary taxi rides.
Edited 7 days ago Chongqing
bodyZh:
1/2
把高德顺风车当盲盒开，这体验居然有点上头
以前用打车软件，只求快点来、快点到。最近因为跨城看朋友，开始频繁用高德顺风车，突然发现这玩意儿的核心体验，其实有点像开盲盒。 你永远不知道接单的会是什么车、什么性格的车主。有次去隔壁市，接单的是个开SUV的大哥，后备箱乱七八糟塞满了他钓鱼的装备，一上车就跟我大聊特聊他昨天钓了条多大的鱼；还有一次，是个开着小电车的年轻女车主，车里布置得香香的，一路放着我们都很喜欢的播客，安安静静地开到了目的地。 而且，这种“盲盒”不仅指车主，还有路线。有时候车主不按导航走，反而会带你绕进一些平时根本注意不到的小路，看到不一样的风景。 最关键的是，开这个盲盒的成本极低，价格一般只有打车的一半。花更少的钱，体验到不同的人间百态，每次发完行程等匹配的时候，甚至还有点小期待。这大概就是顺风车跟普通打车的区别吧。
编辑于 7天前 重庆

title: I will never take carpooling again.
titleZh: 以后再也不坐顺风车了
body:
I will never take carpooling again.
1⃣️Two times out of five exclusive rides, the driver will pick up private work, often spending the exclusive ride money to buy shared ride services. 2⃣️There is no use in taking a taxi in advance. Many drivers will cancel the order before departure, breaking your plan. 3⃣️What makes me feel even more unreasonable is the current trend on the Internet: many people only help drivers to settle accounts, but they will not help passengers to settle accounts. The driver makes no money after being charged a commission, so it is reasonable for exclusive rides to accept private jobs. Passengers pay extra to take an exclusive ride, but they deserve to enjoy the shared ride service. If you want to enjoy the benefits of an exclusive ride, you must add the money to the express bus.
10-01 Guangdong

title: This is the first time I experienced AutoNavi carpooling and I got a refund within seconds. This after-sales service is really good.
titleZh: 第一次体验高德顺风车秒退款，这售后真行啊
body:
1/2
This is the first time I experienced AutoNavi carpooling and I got a refund within seconds. This after-sales service is really good.
It’s my first time to experience AutoNavi carpooling and get refunds in seconds. This after-sales service is really good. When I usually use taxi-hailing software, the biggest headache is when my itinerary changes and I want to cancel or get a refund. The process is cumbersome and sometimes I have to argue with customer service for a long time. I originally made an appointment with AutoNavi Carpooling to meet a client this afternoon, but not long after I got in the car, the client suddenly called me and said that the meeting was temporarily cancelled. I hung up the phone and awkwardly explained the situation to the car owner. The older brother was very nice and said it was okay and dropped me off nearby. The order on my mobile phone has already been placed. I thought that the fare for this trip would have to be deducted as usual. After all, it was my unilateral breach of contract. Later, I still couldn't hold it back, so I asked a question about the cost on the order page, and simply wrote, "I only sat for a short period because of something unexpected. Can I get a refund for the price difference?" As a result, before I even reached the subway station, a refund notification popped up on my phone. When I clicked on it, I saw that the platform directly refunded me the cost of the journey I didn’t take, without even having to wait for human customer service. This processing speed really surprised me. If I encounter an emergency again in the future, I will feel confident.
12 hours ago Beijing

body:
Is Didi carpooling really a success?
A few days ago, I called Didi Carpooling and asked the driver how long it would take to arrive. The driver said 4-5 hours, which is indeed within the normal range and acceptable. As a result, it took more than three hours to pick up other passengers in the departure city. Who knows what it feels like to sit in the same place for more than three hours. The originally four- to five-hour drive actually took almost nine hours to arrive. I was dizzy. Is this the meaning of carpooling? I apologized to the platform and gave me a 5 yuan coupon.
17 hours ago Jiangsu

title: Carpooling gets more and more annoying
titleZh: 顺风车越打越气
body:
Carpooling gets more and more annoying
I used to think that carpooling was a really good invention. Drivers could make money taking a long trip, and passengers could also save some taxi fares. But now carpooling seems to be no longer "carpooling". According to my personal experience, the current understanding of “carpooling” by ride-hailing drivers is “the ability to pick up ride-hailing of several people at the same time”, and one trip can earn two people’s money. It has even reached the point where he refuses to drive without two people. The main package requires frequent cross-regional commuting due to work reasons. Because it is a medium- to long-distance ride, there are very few people who take orders for ride-hailing. In comparison, carpooling orders can be received almost in seconds, and the price is one-third cheaper, so I usually choose carpooling more often. But recently, I feel that the carpooling experience has become worse and worse. Here are a few examples: Driver 1: After picking up my car, he parked the car on the side of the road and waited for the order. Driver 2: I couldn't be contacted after taking the order, which caused me to change my high-speed rail ticket. Driver 3: This driver and Driver 2 took a taxi on the same day. Because Driver 2 couldn't be contacted, the taxi was canceled and retaken. He originally planned to ask me to wait for another half an hour because he wanted to pick up another person. I told him that I had to catch the high-speed rail before he reluctantly set off. He kept asking me to add money to him on the way, but I refused. (Driver 3 told me that Driver 2 didn’t answer the phone because he didn’t receive the second order, so he didn’t want to take my order.) Finally, he asked me not to take the shared ride. If I called the exclusive ride, it wouldn’t waste time. Driver 4: After listening to Driver 3’s words, I paid more for the exclusive ride. Driver 4 still asked to pick up one more person. I argued with him, but he blamed me for paying more for the exclusive ride. The above are just a few typical examples. In fact, I encounter one of the 4 types almost every time. I'm really too weak, don't scold me, because time is more important to me, so I don't bother to worry about it. It would be very troublesome to cancel and replay. I have reported them, but my account can only be banned for a day or two at most. These drivers have multiple accounts, and it is useless to ban their accounts. In addition, regarding the price of shared ride, these drivers have several numbers, so they cannot enjoy the shared ride price at all. In other words, passengers can only enjoy shared ride level services but have to pay the exclusive ride fee.
06-08
bodyZh:
顺风车越打越气
以前我觉得顺风车真的是好发明，司机走一趟长途可以有钱赚，乘客也可以省一点打车钱，但是现在顺风车好像不再是“顺风车”了。根据我个人的亲身体会，现在网约车司机对“顺风车”的理解就是“可以同时接好几个人的网约车”，跑一趟可以赚两个人的钱。甚至已经到了不满两个人就不肯开车的程度。 主包因为工作原因需要频繁跨区通勤，因为算是中长途，打网约车很少有人接单，相比之下顺风车几乎是秒接单，而且价格也能便宜三分之一，所以平时选择顺风车更多。 但是最近感觉顺风车的体验越来越差了，举几个例子： 司机1：接到我之后把车停在路边等单子，等不到就不走，最后等了半个小时没开车，被我取消订单举报处理。 司机2：接单之后无法联系上，导致我高铁改签 司机3：这个司机和司机2是同一天打的，因为司机2无法联系上所以取消重打，本来也打算让我再等半小时他要再接一个人，我说我要赶高铁他才不情愿地出发，路上一直让我给他加钱，被我拒绝。（司机3告诉我司机2不接电话是因为没有接到第二单所以不想接我这单）最后还让我不要打拼车，打专享就不会耽误时间了。 司机4：听了司机3的话加钱打了专享，司机4依然要求再接一个人，我与之争辩，他反而怪我为什么要加钱打专享。 以上只是举了几个典型例子，实际上我现在几乎每次都会碰到4种中的一种。我确实太软弱了别骂我，因为对我来说时间更重要所以懒得计较，如果取消重新打会很麻烦。举报也举报过，最多也只能封号一两天，这些司机有好几个号，封号也没用的。 另外关于拼车的价格，这些司机都是有好几个号的，所以根本享受不到拼车价，也就是说，乘客只能享受到拼车水平的服务但是却要付独享的费用。
06-08

title: Carpooling sister taught me a lesson
titleZh: 顺风车姐给我上了一课
body:
LIVE
LIVE
LIVE
Carpooling sister taught me a lesson
I was the last one to get on the bus after carpooling and I was the last one to get on the bus. The person sitting in the front seat was a girl with red highlights. Her hair looked messy, but in fact it was very stylish. After I sat down, she started to sing, and she sang well. "The distant mountains are calling me~" "If you don't love me!" Then he started chatting with the driver and the people next to him. "Where do you live from?" "Master, are you tired?" She was very enthusiastic and enthusiastic. She talked and sang for a while. My sister took out the strawberries and started handing them out one by one. They all refused, and I was the last one to be handed out. When I saw the red strawberries in front of me, I was a little excited, but I thought no one wanted them, so I waved my hand. When I saw that no one was willing to eat them, I pinched the stems of the strawberries and handed them to me. I took them and ate them, it was very sweet. Everyone else also ate. We arrived at the service area soon, and it was time for dinner. I bought a cake to eat in the car and said why don't you guys buy some food. The elder brother next to me asked if this cake cost ten yuan. She said loudly and cheerfully, "No, it's eight yuan. No matter how expensive it is, you can't go hungry." She was also very concerned about the driver. Is he tired after driving for so long? Why didn't the guy who just got off the bus pay the highway tolls? I'll pay it now. You work so hard, I may not be able to run away. My sister was the second one to get off the bus. As soon as we got to her house, she started to introduce us to the scenic spots we saw. After getting off the bus, she said, "Come down, I'll treat you to mutton soup." When she got off the bus, the driver said he was so angry.
02-11

title: I was carpooling on a rainy night. I didn’t say a few words, but I remembered them for a long time.
titleZh: 雨夜打到顺风车，没说几句话，但记了好久
body:
I was carpooling on a rainy night. I didn’t say a few words, but I remembered them for a long time.
Last month, I worked overtime until ten o'clock. The subway stopped, it rained again, and the taxi queue was over fifty. I tried carpooling on Amap, but I didn’t expect anyone to actually pick up the call. The car owner was a female car owner in her early thirties. As soon as she got in the car, she looked at me and asked, "Are you feeling uncomfortable?" I said I had a fever. Without asking any more questions, she adjusted the direction of the air conditioner and turned off the music: "You squint for a while. I'll call you when you get there." She stopped at a convenience store, got out of the car and bought a bottle of water and handed it to me without saying a word. When she got downstairs, she didn't turn off the engine and said, "Come up, don't catch a cold." After returning, she even tipped the car on the platform. Owner, in retrospect, it had nothing to do with whether the car was clean or not, but when I was feeling uncomfortable and exhausted, this kind of kindness that was just right and did not cross the line can really be remembered for a long time.
09-16
bodyZh:

上个月加班到十点，地铁停了，又下着雨，打车排到五十多位。在高德上试了试顺风车，没想到真有人接。 车主是一位三十出头女车主，一上车就看了我一眼："是不是不舒服？"我说有点发烧。她没多问，把空调风向调了调，关了音乐："你眯一会儿，到地方我叫你。 中间她在便利店停了一下，下车买了瓶水递给我，全程没多说一句。到楼下她没熄火，"快上去，别着凉了"。回去之后还专门在平台打赏了这位车主，事后回想，跟车里干不干净没关系，就是在在浑身难受、疲惫的时候，这种恰到好处、不越界的善意，真的能记很久。

title: Hate shared rides
titleZh: 讨厌拼车
body:
Hate shared rides
At first, four people were picked up in the car, and then they were dropped off one by one. I was far away and the last person dropped off me. I can understand it, but I don’t understand it when I drop off one person and have to pick them up again. Isn’t everyone’s time? , I originally thought that the shared ride would not be particularly time-consuming, but when I walked from Renshou to Dujiangyan at 2:30 in the afternoon, it was already 8:30 in the evening. It only took me 3 hours to take the subway and bus, and it only cost 40 yuan. I took the shared ride for 65. Not only did the ride time become longer, but I also walked a longer distance and kept taking detours.

title: Didi is probably the best I have ever seen in redefining "shared ride success"
titleZh: 滴滴大概是我见过最擅长重新定义“拼车成功”
body:
1/5
Didi is probably the best I have ever seen in redefining "shared ride success"
Didi is probably one of the platforms I have seen that is best at redefining “shared ride success”. Today, I took the carpooling shared ride. All four passengers completed the shared ride normally through the platform, and the actual number of passengers has obviously reached the shared ride status. When placing an order, the platform swore that if the shared ride of this order is successful, a cashback of 10 yuan will be given. The result? The car was actually booked, and the seats were indeed filled with passengers. However, the cashback promised by the platform was like suddenly entering the state of "Schrödinger's shared ride success" - as long as it involves cashing in on the offer, the ride can be declared "unfinished." What’s even more interesting is that after I contacted customer service to ask about the cashback issue, the customer service kept explaining repeatedly that “the order was not completed”. But when I further explained that there were indeed other shared ride passengers on the car, the platform’s approach became very “flexible”: since the platform itself couldn’t explain it, it directed the problem to the driver. This way of handling is indeed very "platform wise" - when making discounts, it's about the rules, when it's cashing out, it's about the system, and when there's a dispute, it's about the driver. As for whether consumers actually completed the shared ride, it became the least important thing. I originally just came to inquire about the 10 yuan cashback promised by the platform, but in the end I experienced a complete process of "how to transfer the platform's responsibilities layer by layer" inexplicably. Of course, the platform finally stated that it would deal with the relevant drivers and promised to "suspend services and permanently ban them in serious cases." As for the cash rebate issue that consumers initially reported, it was downplayed. It has to be said that this service concept is indeed breathtaking: consumers are required to believe in the rules of the platform, and the rules can be reinterpreted when the rules really need to be fulfilled. The 10 yuan is actually not important. What is important is that if a platform can so easily shirk its promises to consumers, then what should consumers believe? I hope Didi will continue to maintain this "user first" service attitude in the future. After all, it is a rare ability to handle such a simple cashback issue with such twists and turns.
10-07 Guangxi
bodyZh:
1/5
滴滴大概是我见过最擅长重新定义“拼车成功”
滴滴大概是我见过最擅长重新定义“拼车成功”的平台之一。 今天乘坐顺风车拼车，四位乘客均通过平台正常完成拼车，实际乘车人数也已经明显达到拼车状态。下单时平台信誓旦旦地承诺：若本单拼车成功，将返现10元。 结果呢？车是实实在在地拼上了，乘客也确确实实坐满了，唯独平台承诺的返现，像是突然进入了“薛定谔的拼车成功”状态——只要涉及兑现优惠，就可以宣布这趟车“没有拼成”。 更有意思的是，在我联系客服询问返现问题后，客服始终围绕“订单未拼成”反复解释。可当我进一步说明车上确实有其他拼车乘客后，平台的处理思路又开始变得十分“灵活”：既然平台自己不好解释，那就把问题往司机身上引导。 这种处理方式确实很有“平台智慧”——优惠的时候讲规则，兑现的时候讲系统，出了争议再讲司机。 至于消费者到底有没有实际完成拼车，反而成了最不重要的事情。 我本来只是来咨询一笔平台自己承诺的10元返现，最后却莫名其妙体验了一套“如何把平台责任层层转移”的完整流程。 当然，平台最后表示会处理相关司机，并承诺所谓“暂停服务、情节严重永久封禁”。至于消费者最开始反映的返现问题，倒是被轻描淡写地带过了。 不得不说，这种服务理念确实令人叹为观止：既要消费者相信平台的规则，又可以在规则真正需要兑现的时候重新解释规则。 这10块钱其实并不重要，重要的是——一个平台如果连自己主动向消费者作出的承诺都可以如此轻易地推诿，那么消费者究竟应该相信什么？ 希望滴滴以后继续保持这种“用户至上”的服务态度，毕竟能把一件如此简单的返现问题处理得如此曲折，也算是一种难得的能力。
10-07 广西

title: Please consider business seats (lightning protection) carefully when returning from the Kai Tak concert
titleZh: 启德演唱会回来请慎重考虑商务座（避雷）
body:
LIVE
1/3
Please consider business seats (lightning protection) carefully when returning from the Kai Tak concert
After a concert in Kai Tak, I returned to the mainland and wanted to be more comfortable. I booked a shared ride in a business car, priced at 258 seats. It turned out to be the worst experience of the night. Off topic: The first male in the world this week! 1⃣ We agreed to meet at 22:55 and go to Shenzhen Bay, but the driver actually arrived at 23:10 and changed to Huanggang without saying a word. The group notified us that we must be at the boarding point before 22:55. We basically arrived on time, only one person was a little late, but the bus did not leave until 23:10 at the end. Delay was not the problem of the passengers at all. Before departure, people in the group kept talking about taking the Shenzhen Bay route and kept urging people to do so. However, when we arrived, we went directly to Huanggang without consulting any passengers during the entire journey. Huanggang was crowded with people last night and was stuck in traffic for a long time. My friend started the bus 10 minutes later than me and took the Shenzhen Bay route, which was smooth sailing. Changing the port was a decision that delayed everyone's time, and the driver didn't even say hello. Later, I was told that the port of call is decided by the driver alone. 2⃣ The boarding point was notified of the taxi stand here, but it was actually on the opposite side. There was no reminder in the group. The boarding point notified was at Exit D of the MTR station. You have to turn right and walk a while before going out. It is already far away from Kai Tak. When we arrived at the taxi stand where it was supposed to be, we searched for a long time and couldn't find the taxi. Finally we found out that it was at another taxi stand across the road. The driver didn't say "on the other side" in the group the whole time, and by default every passenger knew. The "business seat" of 3⃣ 258 is actually the connection between two seats, with a raised handle that presses against the waist (actual photo from P2). This is the most annoying thing. I can accept the random seats, but the position I was in was not a normal seat at all. It was at the joint between the two seats, with a hard handle protruding and pressing against my waist. This is not a short trip. If you sit down for a long distance, your waist will be completely useless. First of all, let me make it clear that I ran to get on the bus the whole way without delaying even a second. It’s not because I am slow that I can only sit in this seat. And even if I sit in such a seat, I have the nerve to pay 258? ? This car has a total of 6 seats, only 3 of which are normal VIP seats, and the remaining 3 people are squeezed into the small space in the back row - but the 6 people paid exactly the same price, 258. I checked the review section of his store and found that I was not the only one who was fooled (P3): some passengers encountered the same waiting and seat problems. A reminder for those who want to share ride back to Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Foshan and Dong after watching the performances in Kai Tak and Yabo: ① Before placing the order, ask questions in the chat: which port to go to, whether you can choose a seat, whether there are extra seats in the back row, and keep a written record ② Ask the driver to take photos for confirmation after arrival ③258 is really not cheap. This kind of "junction seat" is not worth it at all. It is better to choose a cross-border bus. Consider this kind of shared ride carefully.

启德演唱会回来请慎重考虑商务座（避雷）
启德看完演唱会回内地，想舒服点订了商务车拼车，258一个座，结果成了当晚最糟心的体验。 题外话：the weeknd世男一！ 1⃣ 说好22:55集合、走深圳湾，司机实际到达已经23:10，最后一声不吭改走皇岗 群里通知22:55前必须到上车点，我们基本都准时到，只有一个人晚了点，但车最后23:10才走，拖延根本不是乘客的问题。出发前群里一直说走深圳湾，一个劲催人，结果临了直接走皇岗，全程没跟任何乘客商量。昨晚皇岗人山人海，堵了很久；我朋友比我晚10分钟发车，人家走的深圳湾，一路顺畅。改口岸这种耽误所有人时间的决定，司机连个招呼都不打。事后跟我说口岸由司机一个人决定 2⃣ 上车点通知的是这边的士站，实际在对面，群里一句提醒都没有 通知的上车点在地铁站D口，出去还要右转再走一段，本来就离启德有距离。到了按说的位置找的士站，找了半天找不到车，最后才知道是在马路对面的另一个的士站上的车。司机全程没在群里说一句"在对面"，默认每个乘客都知道。 3⃣ 258的"商务座"，实际是两张座椅的连接处，凸起把手全程顶腰（P2实拍） 最气的是这个。座位随机我可以接受，但我那个位置根本不是正常座位，是两个座椅中间的拼接处，一个硬把手凸起来，一路顶着腰。这可不是短途，长途坐下来腰直接废掉。 首先声明，我全程跑过去上车点一秒没耽误，不是因为我自己慢悠悠才只能坐这个，而且就算坐这样的座位也好意思卖258？？ 这车一共6个座，只有3个是正常VIP座，剩下3个人挤在后排狭小空间里——但6个人付的钱一模一样，都是258。 翻了下他家评价区，被坑的不止我一个（P3）：有乘客遇到同样的等待和座位问题 给之后启德、亚博看完演出想拼车回深广佛莞的姐妹提个醒： ①下单前在聊天里问死：走哪个口岸、能不能选座、后排是不是加座，留好文字记录 ②让司机到达后拍照确认 ③258真不便宜，这种"连接处座位"完全不值，能选跨境巴士的反而更好，慎重考虑这种拼车

titleZh: 拼车后续｜拼车司机夸夸贴
body:
1/9
Shared ride follow-up｜shared ride driver praises and posts
✨Chiang Mai shared ride｜A blessing in disguise! I found a treasure and the Chinese driver praised me ✨ Originally, my friend Momo suddenly missed the appointment, so the shared ride was cancelled. I was a little depressed, but I didn’t expect that I made an appointment with a great driver! Originally, the initial itinerary only included Sticky Waterfall + Elephant Baba Papermaking, but we temporarily added Elephant Camp and Blue Temple the night before, and the chef readily agreed! The key point is to be fluent in Chinese, there is no need to worry about communication barriers, and the whole process is smooth in Chinese 👍 ✅ We were picked up at the hotel on time in the morning, and we officially set off after checking the itinerary 💦First stop | Sticky Waterfall. The chef was super considerate! We prepared mosquito repellent in advance, and even lent us a waterproof mobile phone bag to deliver to the entrance. After the tour, we even helped deliver a change of clothes to the store. It was full of details! 🔵Second stop | Blue Temple. At the door, he also shared the local bananas he brought, which were sweet and delicious~ He took us to the main hall first, patiently taught us the etiquette of worshiping Buddha, and then we were free to visit. After shopping, we were treated to an amazing durian ice cream 🍦 🐘The third stop | Elephant Camp happened to be raining heavily and there were very few tourists! The interaction with elephants is a great experience! Little easter egg 🥰 There is a very cute little elephant. It has been playing on the swing and is still stuck on the swing. Finally, the elephant mother comes to help rescue it. It is so cute! 📜The fourth stop｜Elephant Papa Papermaking Experience Camp: Hand-laying paper + DIY crafts, very interesting! 💆On the way back, I heard that we wanted to cook horse and chicken, and the chef recommended a shop opened by his sister, which is near the ancient city! The technique is very authentic and the acupuncture points are found very accurately. I feel slightly sweaty after the massage and my legs feel relaxed! 💡: This master is more than just a driver! He is also a translator, local tour guide, and will also help with taking photos. He is attentive and reliable! I was originally in a bad mood because of the no-show, but it turned out to be a blessing in disguise~ Friends who come to Chiang Mai and want to rent a car can really go to this master!

title: After watching the princesses who will share the ride home that day!
titleZh: 看完当天要拼车回家的公主们！
body:
1/3
After watching the princesses who will share the ride home that day!
To share some experience, first find enough people with similar destinations to share the ride together. I asked for "exclusive ride high-end car" at Hello Carpooling, and then chose "bear all highway tolls". I went back to Wuhan for six hours, and the cost per capita for four people was 275, which is about the same as the price of a commercial vehicle. Those who sit in the front row can use a little more A. If the destination is closer, it will usually be OK to take a short detour to take me home. ps: Business cars are randomly shared for rides, or are only delivered to high-speed rail stations. It is inconvenient to take a taxi home, and the cars that are often sports cars are in average condition and the long-distance experience is not good. The prices of carpooling shared rides or ordinary exclusive rides are low, and no one is willing to take them. The car owners who are willing to take them are a mixed bag, and random shared rides are given here and there, which is not smooth at all and is very time-consuming. High-end car owners are generally more selective about orders. They are willing to take orders if the price is relatively good. They will not pick up others, and there is no need to argue. It is good. You can choose a spacious and comfortable car without paying first, and the driver must have driving experience. You can also call the car owner to confirm the time. You can cancel if you have not agreed. I think the price is reasonable and acceptable. After all, driving is quite hard. I have taken taxis like this several times, and they are always punctual, trustworthy and easy to communicate with. We also rode punctually and quietly! And if you check this box, your order will be received very quickly, and you can go in both directions! pps: In addition, you can choose to gather at the outlet parking lot (at the Ferris wheel opposite the venue). Parking is free, easy to find, and relatively close. If there is a more suitable meeting point please let me know! ! [心心眼R] I hope everyone can find a good car and a good car owner and get home safely and comfortably [reply hello] [reply hello]

title: A shared ride trip to Arctic Village, a day spent with five strangers
titleZh: 北极村拼车出游，五个陌生人结伴的一天
body:
/
A shared ride trip to Arctic Village, a day spent with five strangers
When I got off the bus to pick up my luggage, I chatted with a gentle sister. I learned that she was traveling alone. She met a fellow villager in the car, a boy who was also traveling alone. We discussed that the three of us could go on a shared ride together. We all arrived at our respective accommodations first and put our luggage. We stayed in a B&B. The two girls next door to me wanted to go on a shared ride. The owner of the B&B suggested that he could take us along, so I sent a message to ask if the sister and the little boy I met after getting off the bus wanted to go together. They readily agreed. So the five of us set off together. It was a great experience. Although it was the first time we met, everyone had good personalities. We took care of each other and chatted along the way. We had a lot of fun on the trip. We were not lonely or embarrassed at all.
4 hours ago Heilongjiang

Today's return journey was still a bit congested... we will stop at about four or five scenic spots along the way, where you can take photos and check in. The main ones are the large prayer flags ➡️Gate of the Sky Observation Deck ➡️I can't name it but you can stack Manidui Lake ➡️Jiaorong Village Prairie ➡️ Drive all the way back to the ancient city It is indeed the closest place to heaven. You can take pictures at any time. You can feel the wind of freedom in the prairie. Some random thoughts: I accidentally saw a shared ride post on my trip to Shangri-La. I didn’t expect it to be an unexpected and awesome experience. It was well worth the money.
I met the e-Ren driver who has many experiences and has many jobs. Unexpectedly, he is also the owner of a B&B! Two days and one night in Jiuzhaigou, only personal experience, for reference only
We went to Jiuzhaigou on the 24th and 25th. 1. Regarding high reflexes: It varies from person to person. My personal constitution is more prone to high reflexes. It is said that Jiuzhaigou is not prone to high altitude sickness. But I had high fever when I went to Jiuzhaigou a few years ago. Whenever I go to plateau areas, I have high fever. My symptom of high fever is headache. This time I took my mother there. I ate Rhodiola rosea a week in advance and Gaoyuanan on the day of the trip. Neither my mother nor I had high fever this time in Jiuzhaigou! 2. Regarding dressing: My mother and I both wear three-in-one jackets, jeans + long johns. The temperature difference between morning and evening is really big, so the three-in-one jacket is really convenient. 3. Regarding transportation: high-speed rail + shared ride. Before traveling, I read a lot of guides. Some said shared rides were good, while others said they were bad. I still hesitated for a long time and chose shared ride! I don’t want to take the bus, it takes a long time + I’m afraid of motion sickness. The car I got this time is a nine-seater business car, which is really comfortable to sit in! The driver is also very nice, and he doesn't drive very fast. They have a speed limiter installed on the car, which will start to remind you when you exceed the speed limit. The master will take you to a hotel near the scenic spot or a place to store your luggage according to the needs of the passengers on the bus. I live in Guou Nei, and there is a centralized place for storing luggage. As soon as I mentioned my name, the master knew where it was. After I put it there, I continued to get on the bus and took it directly to the entrance of the scenic spot. On the return trip, it is also a shared ride. However, during the recent peak period, nine-seater commercial vehicles were restricted at the entrance of the scenic spot and could not come to pick up people. They were waiting in the Moon Bay parking lot. Be sure to pay attention to the time! The shared ride was at 5pm. We left the scenic area at 16:30, and then went to the cultural and creative store to buy something.
, thinking that the shuttle bus is very close to the Moon Bay parking lot, and it will be there in a few minutes. But it’s not like this. There are a lot of people queuing up for the shuttle bus during peak hours, and there are not that many shuttle buses. Seeing that it was 5 o’clock in more than ten minutes, I quickly took my mother to the opposite road and took a taxi to the Moon Bay parking lot (10 yuan/person). 4. Regarding accommodation: I really recommend staying in the scenic area! It’s really convenient and saves a lot of elbow strikes! We stayed in a B&B near Sunilang Central Station, and it was really convenient to take the bus! The room in the B&B I stayed in was quite large, and the floor heating was super sufficient, so I didn’t have to be afraid of the cold at all. If you stay at a B&B in Gouni, you must enter the scenic spot before 2 p.m., and you cannot enter the scenic spot after 2 p.m. 5. Regarding play: On the first day, my mother and I entered the park at 1pm. It was not crowded at all at that time. We wanted to go to the left line to play. The bus was bound for the right line, so we transferred to the left line at Sunset Lang Center! After playing the left lane on the first day, we went back to the B&B to rest. At 8:05 the next morning, we went out to Sunset Lang Center to take the bus bound for the right line. It was not crowded at all when we got on the bus, and everyone got on the bus in an orderly manner. It was on the sightseeing bus from Panda Sea to Wucai Pond that I felt the power of the elbow! The seniors are all warriors, very powerful
. During other times, it was fine. It was crowded but people got on the bus in an orderly manner and no one jumped in line. The center line we went to in the afternoon was not too crowded. It is recommended to hike from the Spark Sea to the Reed Sea. This road is really beautiful. The weather is good and the walk is really beautiful!
15 hours ago Sichuan

九寨沟两天一夜，仅个人体验，仅供参考
我们是24号和25号去的九寨沟 1、关于高反：因人而异，我个人体质比较容易高反。都说九寨沟不容易高反。但是我几年前去九寨沟的时候就高反了，我一去高原地区都要高反。我的高反症状就是头疼。这次我是带我妈妈去的，我就提前一星期吃了红景天，旅程当天吃了高原安。这次九寨沟我和我妈都没有高反！ 2、关于穿衣：我和我妈都穿的是三合一的冲锋衣，牛仔裤+秋裤。早晚温差真的很大，三合一冲锋衣真的挺方便的。 3、关于交通：高铁+拼车。出行前，我看了很多攻略，有说拼车好的，也有说不好的。我还是犹豫了很久，选择了拼车！我不想坐大巴，时间久+害怕晕车。我这次拼到的车是九座商务车，坐起来真的很安逸！师傅人也挺好的，开车也不快，他们车上装的有限速的记录仪，一超速就开始提醒了。师傅会按车上乘客的需求，把大家送到景区附近的酒店或者放行李的地方。我住的是沟内，有一个集中放行李的地方，我一说名字，师傅都清楚是那里，直接拉过去放了之后，继续上车可直接送到景区门口。 返程时，也是拼车。但是最近高峰期，九座商务车在景区门口是限行了的，不能过来接人，他们是在月亮湾停车场等。一定要注意时间！拼车是下午5点，我们是16:30出的景区，然后又去文创店买了东西
，想着摆渡车到月亮湾停车场很近，几分钟就到了。但是 并不是这样的 高峰期摆渡车排队的人爆多，摆渡车辆也不是那么多，眼看着还有十多分钟就5点了，我赶紧拉着我妈到对面马路打了个黑车，去了月亮湾停车场（10元/人）。 4、关于住宿：我真的超级推荐住景区内！真的很方便，可以减少很多肘击！我们是住在落日朗中心站附近的民宿，坐车真的很方便！我住的这个民宿房间挺大的，地暖超级足，完全不用怕冷。住沟内民宿，必须在下午两点之前进入景区，两点以后景区不能再进入。 5、关于游玩：第一天我和我妈是下午一点入园的，那时候一点都不挤，我们想去左线玩，车子是开往右线的，我们就在落日朗中心换乘了去左线的车！第一天玩完左线，我们就回民宿休息了。 第二天早上8:05我们出门去落日朗中心乘坐去右线的车，上车时一点都不挤，大家都很有序上车。就是从熊猫海到五彩池的观光车，我感受到了肘击的威力！老年团们都是勇士，非常厉害
。其他时间段都还好，挤但是有序上车 没人乱插队这些。下午我们去的中线，也不怎么挤。推荐从火花海徒步走到芦苇海，这一路真的太美了，25好天气好，走下去真的很漂亮！

title: It was my first time to go to Guilin, and the experience was different from what was said online.
titleZh: 第一次去桂林，体验感和网上说的不一样
body:
LIVE

1/5
It was my first time to go to Guilin, and the experience was different from what was said online.
It is my first time to go to Guilin. I would like to share my opinions, which can be used as a reference for Xiaohongshu’s brothers. Day 1: We set off from Shenzhen, taking the high-speed train at 8 o’clock, and it was already around 12 o’clock when we arrived at the hotel room. The weather is very cool in October, and the walk along Binjiang Road between the Sun and Moon Twin Towers and Jiefang Bridge is extremely comfortable and relaxing. I also booked a hotel near here, with Zhengyang Pedestrian Street behind it (this pedestrian street is more ordinary, an ordinary pedestrian street). I went to Elephant Trunk Hill in the afternoon (to be honest, it felt very ordinary, and it was a good place to go. After going to Elephant Trunk Hill, you can also take a taxi to any scenic spot, the price is not expensive, about 10 yuan). In the evening, I went to Riyue Bay Pier and took a walk in the direction of Ronghu Lake. It was not bad, and the check-in point was also on this road. The next day: Here is the highlight. When traveling on the Li River, it is recommended to go directly from Mopanshan to Yangshuo. And you have to buy the Samsung cruise that leaves at 9 a.m., the price is 213/person, so it won’t be very hot in the middle. My recommendation is not to listen to what Xiaohongshu said and buy the best section. The best section is from Yangshuo to Guilin. This way you have to take a taxi back when you get there, which is a waste of time. Moreover, most of the road from Mopan Mountain to Guilin has very good scenery. It is not bad to enjoy the scenery on the boat, and you can catch up on your sleep later. After arriving in Yangshuo, you can actually check in for the Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains Tour within the limited time. Just buy the group ticket for the Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains directly on Meituan. The round trip only costs 75 (but the boarding and alighting time is fixed, which is definitely enough time to check in). Don’t listen to the online talk about shared rides. Shared rides cost 50 one way and are difficult to get back. Buying tickets on Meituan includes return trip. Day 3: Yulong River Bamboo Rafting in the morning. Just listen to the information on the Internet. You can buy the best section and take a taxi back to Gongnongqiao Comprehensive Wharf for 6 yuan. All scenic spots such as Yinziyan, Xianggong Mountain, and Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains are purchased from Meituan, which includes tickets and transportation. Don't take a shared ride on Xiaohongshu, it's a waste of time. (I see some people say that shared rides are one-way. If you don’t believe me, you can try it yourself.
) Shili Gallery and other attractions where you need to rent electric vehicles. My advice is, don't rent. The sun is very strong and can cause sunburn, and from my point of view, Shili Gallery is just an ordinary farmhouse. I didn’t see any pastoral scenery, or I was going to ride into an unknown rural area. When going to Yinziyan, Shuiedi Pier and other places, you will pass by Shili Gallery. Regarding eating: The Guilin Shaode Xiaoyaolou store has plenty of portions and the taste is OK (note, the portions are very generous!); Yangshuo Wangjiang Restaurant is also OK (sour and spicy); Lao Xu’s feels like it’s passable; Huahong Xike is a failing restaurant for me, so be careful! About accommodation: Guilin lives near the Sun and Moon Twin Towers. If you live in Yangshuo, you can have the best view of the Yulong River, or if you live near the Li River, don't be too far from West Street (but West Street itself is actually relatively ordinary). Note: Xianggong Mountain and Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains are two scenic spots, one for sunrise and one for sunset. However, both of them are more productive if you go to check in in the morning; Yinziyan will put up some messy lanterns on the rock wall, so you don’t have to go if you don’t have time; the experience that Shili Gallery focuses on may not be as good as the Li River Cruise
13 hours ago Guangxi

第一次去桂林，体验感和网上说的不一样
第一次去桂林，分享一下我的看法，可以给小红书的兄弟们参考参考 第一天：我们是从深圳出发，8点的高铁，到酒店房间的时候已经12点左右了。 10月天气很凉爽，日月双塔到解放桥之间的滨江路，散步极度舒适，非常放松。我酒店也定的这附近的，后面就是正阳步行街(这个步行街就比较一般了，普通的步行街) 下午去的象鼻山(说实话，感觉很普通，属于可去。去完象鼻山还可以打车到任意景区，价格不贵，10元左右) 晚上去在日月湾码头，往榕湖的方向散步，还不错，打卡点也在这条路上 第二天：这里开始是精华了。游漓江，建议直接从磨盘山到阳朔。而且要买早上9点开的那趟三星游船，价格213/人，这样到中途也不是很热。我推荐是不要听小红书上说买精华路段，精华路段是的游玩方向是从阳朔往桂林那个方向开的，这样到地方后还要打车回来，很浪费时间。而且磨盘山到桂林的路段前面一大部分风景都很好，在船上吹风赏景还不错，后面可以补觉。 到阳朔后，其实极限时间是可以去打卡千里江山图的，直接在美团上买千里江山图的团票就行，往返只要75(但是上下车时间固定，肯定是够打卡时间的)。千万不要听网上说拼车，拼车单程50而且很难回来。美团上买票包返程。 第三天：早上遇龙河竹筏，这个听网上的就行，买精华路段，到工农桥综合码头可以直接打车回去，6块钱。 银子岩、相公山、千里江山图等等景点一律从美团上买，包门票，包接送。千万不要在小红书上拼车，浪费时间。(我看有些人说拼车是单程，不信可以自己试一下
) 十里画廊等需要租电动车的景点。我的建议是，不租。太阳很大会晒伤，而且十里画廊以我的眼光来看，就是普通农家乐，没有看见什么田园风景，或者说要骑到不知道哪个农村里面去了。去银子岩，水厄底码头等地方都会路过十里画廊。 关于吃饭：桂林勺得逍遥楼店分量很足，味道也还可以(注意，分量很足！)；阳朔望江楼也可以(酸辣口)；老徐家感觉过关吧；花鸿喜客对我来说属于没及格水平，慎去！ 关于住宿：桂林就住日月双塔附近。阳朔住可以看见遇龙河江景的最好，或者住漓江附近，不要离西街太远(但是西街自身其实比较普通) 注意：相公山和千里江山图是2个景点，一个看日出一个看日落。但是两者在早晨的时候去打卡都比较出片；银子岩会打一些乱七八糟的彩灯打在岩壁上，没时间的话可以不去；十里画廊主打的体验感可能不如漓江游轮
13小时前 广西

body:

Detailed money-saving guide for girls to brave Altay alone for 3 days and 2 nights
I received a lot of concerns from girls in private messages about how to play Altay, so I posted a strategy post in the hope that it can help everyone [Bang R][Bang R] 💃Personal situation: I decided to try an aimless trip alone, with no fixed time and no plan, just play as the situation dictates. I am very grateful for the public security management and simple folk customs in the Altay region. I experienced this trip perfectly and flawlessly. Xinjiang is my second hometown! ! ! 🚘The day before departure: 1. Booked a one-night B&B in Baihaba at 10 pm 💰182R 2. Called the owner of the B&B to ask for the shared ride driver’s phone number, and made an appointment for the shared ride from Altay Station to Baihaba 3. Bought the [Baihaba-Kanas-Hemu] winter combined ticket 💰100R. ⚠️⚠️There are no shuttle buses in winter scenic spots‼ ️If you have no snow driving experience, please recommend shared ride. 4. It is very simple to apply for the border defense permit online through the mini program 💃💃 Departure on the first day: 1. Departed at 4 am and took the train from Karamay to Altay (💰58.5R) and arrived at 9 am. The driver picked up on time. The journey took 2 or 4 hours. Be careful to drink less water. The business car has 6 seats and the single shared ride is 200R. The driver is a native of Baihaba, Kazakhstan, which is very nice. 3. Arrive at 1pm and play with two super nice girls from shared ride. There are many hounds raised in the village to resist wild beasts, and cattle and horses roam everywhere; the lambs have gone to the winter pasture, and the summer pasture cannot be visited. Eat: Ashanyu Pot (the spicy beef burger is super delicious, a big one) 💰42R 4. We visited the sky grassland, explored the village, and the observation deck on the right. When we walked deeper into the observation deck, there were many Kazakh locals living inside, and there were also B&Bs. It started to snow that day. For dinner, we recommend the Ranger Restaurant, the local hot pot 💰237R, enough for three girls! It snowed heavily in the evening and went back to the B&B to rest early. 💃💃 Departure on the second day: 1. Prepare to leave for Kanas in the morning. Traffic was restricted due to heavy snow overnight (in winter, the possibility of traffic control must be included in the itinerary). Then we climbed to the observation deck on the left side of Baihaba Village. The whole village was very beautiful in the snow and fog. Lunch Spicy Burger 2. The traffic control was lifted around 12 o'clock. The driver asked his father to drive off-road and take the three of us girls to play. It was equivalent to chartering a car to Kanas and visiting the three bays and one lake for a whole day. It was a great value 💰400R, 133R per person. 3. After the snow, Kanas is simply the king of northern Xinjiang, and the mountains and rivers are astonishing! ! Hiking on the plank road is basically a simple walk for a while - you must take a walk on the plank road by Kanas Lake. It was too cold and I went back to Kanas New Village early in the evening to eat and sleep. Accommodation 💰192R, meals 💰more than 100 (dining in Kanas is expensive) 💃💃Departure on the third day: 1. Get up early and hike from Xincun to Kanas New Bridge (Navigating Queen's Creek), the scenery is not inferior to Sanwan! ! ! 2. Since I was climbing mountains all the time in the first two days and walked tens of thousands of steps every day, my legs were broken on the third day. In addition, it was already several degrees below zero in Kanas and it was a bit torture to go out. In the afternoon, I parted ways with the girls who were traveling with me. I returned to Karamay to rest for a few days and think about the next step. Return to Beitun shared ride💰200R [stick R] end of the battle

女生孤身勇闯阿勒泰3天2夜详细省钱攻略
私信收到很多女孩子关于怎么玩阿勒泰的担忧，发个攻略贴希望能帮助到大家[棒R][棒R] 💃个人情况： 脑门一拍决定一个人尝试漫无目的的旅行，无固定时间无任何计划，随缘玩耍。很感谢阿勒泰地区的治安管理和民风淳朴，丝滑完美毫无瑕疵的体验了这趟旅行，新疆是我的第二故乡！！！ 🚘出发前一天： 1、晚上10点才订好了白哈巴一晚的民宿💰182R 2、跟民宿老板打电话要拼车司机电话，阿勒泰车站到白哈巴拼车约好时间 3、买好【白哈巴—喀纳斯—禾木】冬季联票💰100R。⚠️⚠️冬季景区没有区间车‼️无雪地自驾经验请建议拼车。 4、小程序线上办好边防证，很简单 💃💃第一天出发： 1、凌晨4点出发坐上了克拉玛依到阿勒泰的火车（💰58.5R）早上9点到达，司机准时接 2、4个小时的路程，注意少喝水，商务车6人座，单人拼车💰200R一位，司机是哈萨克族白哈巴本地人非常好 3、下午1点到达，跟拼车两个超nice的女生结伴玩耍。村子里养了很多猎犬抵抗野兽，牛马到处走；小羊们已经去冬牧场，夏之牧场无法参观。吃饭：吖山遇煲（辣皮子牛肉汉堡超好吃，很大一个）💰42R 4、逛了空中草原，探索村落，以及右侧的观景台，观景台再深入走里面住了很多哈萨克本地人，也有民宿）当天就开始下雪，晚饭推荐游侠餐厅，土火锅💰237R，三个女生够吃！晚上下了大雪早早回民宿休息了。 💃💃第二天出发： 1、早上准备出发去喀纳斯，一夜大雪交通管制了（冬季一定把交通管制的可能性做到行程里）接着爬了白哈巴村左侧的观景台，整个村子在雪和雾里非常漂亮。午饭辣皮子汉堡 2、12点左右解除了交通管制，司机请了他爸爸开越野带我们3个女生去玩，等于包车去喀纳斯+玩三湾一湖一整天，超值💰400R，人均133R。 3、雪后喀纳斯简直是北疆王炸，山川封神一整个震撼！！徒步栈道基本都简单走了一会儿～喀纳斯湖边栈道一定要去走走。太冷晚上早早回了喀纳斯新村吃了饭睡觉。住宿💰192R，吃饭💰100多（喀纳斯吃饭贵） 💃💃第三天出发： 1、早起从新村徒步到喀纳斯新桥（导航女王溪），景色不输三湾！！！ 2、由于前两天总在爬山，每天暴走几万步，第三天腿已经废了，加上喀纳斯那边已经零下好几度出门有点折磨，下午跟同行女生分道扬镳，我返回克拉玛依休息几天思考下一步。返程北屯拼车💰200R [棒R]结束战斗
编辑于 5小时前 新疆

title: (The trip to Altay has ended)

(The trip to Altay has ended)
"I'm asking experienced friends to tell me about the transportation and accommodation in Altay. Editor 2: Thank you for your attention. Editor 2 has sorted out my travel time and transportation and accommodation to four scenic spots in northern Xinjiang from October 10 to October 15: Let me summarize first: 1. Shared rides are available! There are many shared ride resources in the Altay area. At first, I was worried that the shared ride advertisements on Xiaohongshu were unreliable and would be put on the plane. Later, I placed an order for shared rides directly on Ctrip. ride, the experience is quite good. The shared ride I found on Little Sweet Potato is also very good. 2. The shuttle bus in the scenic area will be closed after the 16th. I don’t know if it will reopen during the snow season. It may be more suitable to drive into the scenic area. 3. There are many options for accommodation outside the scenic area. I went in the off-season and booked a wooden house in the scenic area, which is not expensive."
Finally, if you like small animals, you can bring some cat and dog food. There are many cats and dogs in Altay, and you can capture their hearts with delicious food.
Edited on 10-14 Xinjiang

title: carpooling master, farewell to carpooling from now on
titleZh: 顺风车主 以后告别顺风车
body:
carpooling master, farewell to carpooling from now on
"Comments from a car owner who has been commuting long distances on weekends for more than a year, carpooling is too useless, don't take orders unless necessary. 1. Today is different from the past, and the price will be too low. During the epidemic, for two people and me as a passenger, for a distance of 200km, my fee was 270 yuan, and the driver got at least 240 yuan. Now, the fee for two people is down to about 160 yuan, and the driver may get 140 yuan. 2. The economy is not good and there are many poor people who are reluctant to give money and their demands are not lowered. This leads to disputes. People who used to take buses, subways and trains thought they could get cheaper premium ride services, and they thought the driver was taking advantage because it saved them money. 3. There are no restrictions on the platform. Both parties can cancel the order at any time without liability or compensation. Your plan will be easily disrupted, and your order will be in an uncertain state. You may have spent a long time driving to his place, and he will say sorry, there is no need for a ride, and just cancel the order. You can just stare at it. It is useless to complain. 4. The cost of communication is too high. Even if the communication is successful, you still have to pick up and deliver the 5-kilometer journey, which may take an extra thirty or forty minutes, plus waiting for someone. The time it takes to get in the car is uncontrollable. You can walk 60 kilometers on the highway in 30 minutes. The time cost is too high, and long-distance commuting is tiring in itself. The more you drive, the more you communicate and the more you worry about, the more tired you will be. If you drive for more than 3 hours, the level of fatigue will increase exponentially. In summary: long-distance carpooling increases the level of fatigue, and short-distance carpooling is not worth the money. 5. If you feel that the platform’s pricing is unreasonable, you may also need to agree to the offline transaction, and there is a risk of cancellation. If you require a deposit, the probability of closing the transaction will be lower, and the communication cost will increase. At the same time, the driver is illegal and is defined as a black driver. If he is reported or found out, he will be fined hugely. If there is an accident, compensation will be very troublesome. If he has a dispute with the passenger, he will complain that you are a black driver, and you will be very passive. 6. After reading the comments, I’ll add another one: Passengers are of different qualities, and it’s disgusting to see people doing vandalism. I just received a call from someone who said she had a grudge and put chewing gum in the groove of my window switch. She also lied about not having children and was actually carrying a 60-year-old mother. To sum up: If you are not very short of money, carpooling car owners should not take the order and drive freely. There will be less constraints and less worries for the passengers. Return to the commuting life of taking the bus, subway, high-speed rail and then taking a taxi. "
Edited on 09-18
bodyZh:
顺风车主 以后告别顺风车
"来自一年多的周末长距离异地通勤车主总结，顺风车太鸡肋，非必要别接单了。 1、今夕不同往日，这会价格压的太低。疫情那会，两个人我作为乘客，200km的距离，我的费用是270元，司机至少到手240元。 现在呢，两个人的费用给压到160元左右，司机可能到手140元。 2、经济不好，穷人多了，舍不得给钱，要求没降低。导致容易产生纠纷。以前坐公交车坐地铁坐火车的人以为能打上便宜的专车了，还认为司机占便宜了，因为给他省钱了。 3、平台没有约束，双方可以随时无责无赔偿取消订单，你的计划容易被打乱，你的订单是不确定状态。你可能费半天劲开车到他那了，他说不好意思，没有坐车需求了，直接取消订单了，你就在原地干瞪眼吧，投诉也没啥用。 4、沟通成本太高，沟通十单成交一单，就算成功还得去接去送，普通道路5公里的路程可能往返要多走三四十分钟，加上等人 上车不可控的时间。三十分钟高速上能走60公里。时间成本太高，长距离通勤，本身就累，多开车多沟通多操心 更累，开车3小时以上，多开一会累的程度是成倍增加的。 总结一句:长距离顺风车增加劳累程度，短距离顺风车这点钱不值当接。 5、如果感觉平台定价不合理，要求线下交易乘客也同意，也有被取消的风险。如果你要求付定金，那么成交的概率会变低，沟通成本增加。同时，司机是违规的，被定义为黑车，被举报或查到是被巨额罚款的，得不偿失。一旦遇到事故，赔偿很麻烦。和乘客有纠纷，他投诉你是黑车，你也很被动。 6、看了评论再加一条:乘客素质不一，遇到故意搞破坏的很恶心。我刚接到过，上高速不系安全带，开窗通风，说了她怀恨在心，把口香糖放我车窗开关凹槽里了，还谎称没小孩老人，实际带着60岁的妈。 综上所述: 如果不是很缺钱，顺风车车主们还是别接单了，自己自由的开车吧，少了羁绊，少了烦恼。 让乘客们继续 回归坐公交转地铁坐高铁然后再打车的通勤生活吧。"
编辑于 09-18
