title: Recording 100 carpooling passengers｜Wangjing met a beautiful sister
titleZh: 记录100位顺风车乘客｜望京遇到漂亮姐姐
body:
1/2
Recording 100 carpooling passengers｜Wangjing met a beautiful sister
📝Female driver born in 2000｜100 carpooling passengers plan It was a warm day today. When I took the order, I met a Beijing lady who works in Wangjing SOHO. We made an appointment to leave at 6:30. The route was smooth and the communication was easy, so I accepted the order. Later, I got off work early and called her to discuss leaving early, and she agreed readily. When we arrived at the pick-up point, we could see her waiting on the roadside from a distance. The young lady is about 170 and super pretty! Seeing that I was a female driver, she asked softly if she could take the passenger seat, saying that she thought it would be more polite. Of course, no problem~ I was very talkative along the way and talked about cars the whole time. She is the most car-savvy girl I have ever seen, and she is also the first passenger to recognize Chiji so far! She said that the cost of gas has been high recently and it is not cost-effective to commute by car, so she commutes by carpooling instead. When we got off the bus at the station, she smiled and said to me: Goodbye, I hope we have another chance to meet again in the future. We meet by chance and stay with us all the way. I wish this beautiful sister everything goes well and see you again soon🌿
8 hours ago Beijing

title: 🚗I pick up an order on the way to and from get off work, and I’ll get my 5 days’ gas expenses back! beat
titleZh: 🚗上下班顺路接个单，5天油费回来啦！打
body:
1/2
🚗I pick up an order on the way to and from get off work, and I’ll get my 5 days’ gas expenses back! hit
Who says commuting by car is just a waste of money? As long as you go along the way, you can earn back your gas expenses while commuting to and from get off work! 🌙 I have been carpooling on my way to and from get off work for the past few days. Not only is the journey not boring, I have also collected 378 yuan in 5 days. I feel like I have saved my gas money this month! Let me show you my "making money along the way" running account 👇 📝**【5-day carpooling small ledger】** 5.18: Drop by after get off work, 1 order each from Amap + Hello = 130.1💰 5.19: If you don’t receive the drop-in, then have a good rest (mainly a random one 😂) 5.20: 1 order from Hello after get off work = 54.7💰 5.21: I was busy commuting to and from get off work, Hello + Gaode = 106.43💰 5.22: Didi ran 2 orders in a row after get off work, Hello 1 order = 86.97💰 📊Total income in 5 days: 378 yuan! ✨**【The carpooling owner’s thoughts】** 1️⃣ It’s really easy! You have to drive to and from get off work anyway, so instead of leaving the passenger seat empty, you might as well pick up a passenger. Not only can we share gas costs, but we can also chat sometimes on the road, and the commuting time flies~ 2️⃣ Multi-platform hanging is more stable. Carpooling is not as fast as Express, but I am used to opening Amap, Hello, and Didi, and pick whichever one I want on the way. The highly matched orders are really delicious! 3️⃣ A calm mind is the most important thing. It doesn't matter if you don't receive an order on May 19th. It's just for making extra money along the way. If you have it, make it. If you don't have it, just treat it as an exclusive ride in the KTV in the car🎤.
Although this 378 yuan is not a huge amount of money, for the workers, it can cover most of the gas expenses for half a month, which is really a sense of accomplishment!

title: Real despair of commuter car owners: new carpooling regulations, what are you doing?
titleZh: 真·通勤车主的绝望：顺风车新规，您这是在
body:
1/3
Real despair of commuter car owners: new carpooling regulations, what are you doing?
As a real car owner who only wants to pick up gas money on the way to and from get off work, the new carpooling regulations this time are simply... 😭 My situation: I am a pure real car owner, commuting on a fixed route every day, and just want to share the gas money with someone along the way. I have never considered it as a full-time job. The current endless loop: I took the order, but couldn’t agree on highway tolls: I took the expressway to make my commute faster, but the passengers were unwilling to buy highway tolls, so I had no choice but to cancel. It was cancelled, and the order completion rate plummeted: The system doesn’t care about you, and the cancellation is my fault. Now my order completion rate for more than 15km has dropped directly to 37.5%! Communicate first without taking the order? It's no use at all! Many people don't read the information at all and can only communicate on the phone. If they want to call, they can only take orders. If communication fails, the order completion rate will still be ugly. The consequences are here: the order completion rate is lower than 70%, and the automatic order grabbing rights are gone! Passengers do not give highway tolls → cancel the order → drop the order completion rate → fail to receive the order → income will return to zero! This is not carpooling, it is clearly "carpooling"! Do you have the same driver? Hug together in the comment area to keep warm!

title: carpooling
titleZh: 顺风车
body:
carpooling
I recently browsed xhs and saw several posts about carpooling, each with its own reasons. Let me tell you my feelings: 1️⃣I think everyone who goes carpooling should choose exclusive rides. For real carpooling, no one will chip in. Because I have a long commute to and from work (60km one way), I occasionally do carpooling, but I have never done so. When you are thinking about how others will earn your three melons and two dates along the way, you should think again that you have saved more than half of your money by taking an express train, and others have to take a detour to pick you up. 2️⃣The person who carpools for orders is essentially trying to take advantage. When he really carpools for various orders, he will say he is in a hurry. (Some people say that you don’t have to accept the carpooling orders I sent. The Indian caste system is difficult to change. The essence is that the upper level has a sense of superiority than the lower level) 3️⃣If you are a full-time carpooling driver and are still collecting rides, I think it is good for you to find a stable job. Or go for a quick ride. In fact, I think the full-time carpooling industry should not even exist, because it has strayed away from the original intention of carpooling. 4️⃣ Why have we been talking about restricting full-time carpooling on various platforms, but it has never been implemented? I think from the platform point of view, if others do it but I don’t do it, then I will lose part of my income source, which is a loss to the company (capital) and is absolutely not allowed. But I think there will definitely be restrictions in the future. (The management is very chaotic now, there is no management at all) 5️⃣*** In unlimited volume, roll until there is no lower limit. However, I only accept those with a smoothness of more than 90%, and I even think that most of them are more than 95%. Detours within 10km if you take the expressway, and within 5km if you don’t take the expressway.
06-30
bodyZh:
顺风车
最近刷xhs，看到好几个顺风车的帖子，各有各的道理。我说一下感受： 1️⃣我觉得打顺风车的都应该选择独享，真正的顺风车，没人凑单。我因为上下班很远（单程60km），偶尔会拉顺风车，从来都没去凑过单。当你在考虑别人反正顺路赚你那三瓜两枣的时候，你应该再想想比打快车已经省了一半不止，别人还要绕路来接你。 2️⃣打顺风车拼单的，本质就是想占便宜，真顺风车各种拼单时，他又会说赶时间。（有些人说我发的顺风车拼单，你可以不接。印度种姓制度很难改变，本质就是上一层比下一层更有优越感） 3️⃣如果你是专职顺风车司机，还在凑顺路单的话，我觉得你找份稳定的工作上班也不错。或者去跑快车。其实我觉得专职顺风车这个行业都不应该出现，因为已经脱离了顺风车的初衷。 4️⃣为什么一直在说要限制各种平台专职顺风车，但是一直没有太落地，我觉得从平台来说，别人做我不做，那我就少了一部分收入来源，对公司（资本）来说，是一种损失，绝对不允许。但是我觉得未来一定会限制。（现在管理很混乱，甚至没啥管理） 5️⃣***在无限的卷，卷到没有下限为止。不过我只接顺路度90%以上的，甚至我觉得绝大部分是95%以上的。走高速绕路10km以内，不走高速5km以内。
06-30

comments.text: Yes, so carpooling has changed.

comments.text: The "carpooling" currently operated by several major platforms controlled by capital are ride-hailing service models such as platform pricing, point-to-point pick-up and drop-off, "exclusive ride", "special exclusive ride", "comfortable ride" and "one order only". In fact, they are ride-hailing without double certificates (commonly known as "black cars"). In addition, the current commission ratio of the platform is extremely high (for example, the maximum of Hello is more than 35-40%), which causes the ride-hailing to think that they pay according to the platform price, and of course they are the "passengers" of "taking a taxi", and then feel that they should enjoy the "service" of ride-hailing. However, at the same time, the price offered by the platform to car owners is extremely low (the minimum per capita per kilometer for long distance is less than 0.22 yuan), and it is naturally impossible for a real car owner to provide the ride-hailing service that ride-hailing expects. Therefore, real car owners (including myself) basically rarely accept orders now because they don’t want to work cheaply for the platform and be sucked by the platform! It can only be said that most of the "carpooling" on the platform are black cars operated by professionals!

title: Blog 15. Side hustle exploration 1: carpooling

body:
Blog 15. Side hustle exploration 1: carpooling
I have only used Dida, and I have been doing it for about 2 months now. I would like to share briefly 1. Remuneration is about 1.4 yuan/km based on the number of kilometers. Basically, only trams can do this at this price. The hourly wage is about 80 yuan. This time is the extra time invested in addition to the part of the journey that you originally had to go. For example: the original commute time is 1 hour, and it takes a total of 2 hours to pick up and drop off people. The extra hour will be paid about 80 yuan. There is a limit on the maximum number of orders accepted in a day. It is said to be 4 orders, but I have not tried it. My current commuting time is 1 hour to 1.5 hours, and the one-way mileage is 45 kilometers. I basically make one order every day after get off work (ranging from 40 to 80 yuan, with an average of about 40 per order). I go out to play and make 1 to 2 orders randomly on weekends. After excluding charging fees, my average monthly extra income is about 800 to 1,000 yuan. This is a situation where office workers already run quite diligently. For reference only. Basically, there are stable free pickup times only after get off work. Due to the morning rush hour in the morning, the risk of being late is too high and it is not recommended. 2. Operation difficulty: The difficulty of getting started is about 0. Just open an account on the Dida app and enter the car and personal information. There are no other additional restrictions and it is not within the scope of operating vehicles. Regarding orders, you set your own starting point and destination on the platform, and the system will recommend orders on its own. New and old customers sometimes send invitations to accept orders. Priority is given to orders with a smoothness of more than 80%. For orders with a smoothness of 80% to 90%, an additional 30 to 45 minutes will be added to your original route. Orders with a smoothness of more than 95% are very rare. The destination of such orders is basically very close to your actual destination. Operation process: publish itinerary, check orders, confirm order receipt, confirm departure, confirm arrival location and receive customers, confirm arrival at destination. Some customers will temporarily release their pigeons. It is best to contact the customer 1 hour before departure to confirm that the itinerary and time are correct. Canceling an order is troublesome and requires customer confirmation, otherwise your credit score will be affected, so try not to cancel. 3. Regarding the car, it is recommended that all passengers sit in the back seat. The back seat should be covered with protective pads to prevent it from getting dirty, and personal belongings and valuables should be placed in the front seat. It is best to buy car insurance that covers passengers. Aromatherapy must be placed inside the car to avoid complaints due to the smell. Passengers are generally willing to play some music or sound, as long as they inform them in advance. It’s best to ban smoking and pets in the car. You can decide this yourself. 4. About the passengers: I have taken at least dozens of passengers so far, and they are basically all friendly and normal. I have never encountered any strange ones, such as drunk people. However, try to keep a sense of distance from passengers. Most people don't like small talk and don't take the initiative to strike up a conversation. A very small number of social cows will take the initiative to chat and just chat with them. Anyone who excessively asks for personal information, tries to get too close, or even sells things will be fooled. Don't be direct, as it may cause complaints and affect the acceptance of orders. 5. Summary The overall cost-effectiveness is low, and it is hard work with little money and tiredness. Now I gradually run less, but for Sheniu drivers, they can indeed meet many interesting strangers, which can be regarded as an interesting life experience.

Blog 15. 副业探索1之顺风车
只用过嘀嗒，目前自己做了2个月左右，做个简单分享 1. 报酬 按公里数折算约1.4元/公里，这个价格基本只有电车能做。时薪80元左右，这个时间是除去自己本来要走的那一段外额外投入的时间，举例：通勤原时长1小时，接人加送人一共花费2h，多出的1h获得报酬约80元。一天有最大接单数量限制，据说是4单，我没有试过。我目前通勤时长1h到1.5h，单程公里数45公里，基本每天下班都会拉一单（40到80元不等，平均下来一单40左右），周末出去玩来回随缘拉1到2单，除掉充电费用平均月额外收入800到1000元左右，这对于上班族已经属于跑的比较勤快的情况，仅供参考。基本只有下班才有稳定自由接客时间，早上由于早高峰，迟到风险太大不建议。 2. 操作难易度 上手难度约为0，滴答app上开账号录入车子和个人信息即可，没有其他额外限制，不属于营运车范围。关于订单，平台上设置好自己的起始点和目的地，系统会自己推荐顺路的订单，新老客户有时也会发来接单邀请，优先选择顺路度80%以上的订单，对于顺路度80%到90%的订单，基本在你原本路途上要增加30到45分钟的额外行程时间，顺路度95%以上的订单非常少，这类订单目的地基本和你的实际目的地距离非常接近。操作流程：发布行程，查看订单，确认接单，确认出发，确认到达地点并接到客户，确认到达目的地。有些客户会临时放鸽子，最好在出发前1小时联络客户确认好行程和时间无误。取消订单比较麻烦，需要客户确认，否则会影响信用分，尽量不要取消 3. 关于车子 建议让乘客都做后座，后座座椅套好保护垫防止弄脏，个人物品和贵重物品都放前座。车子的保险最好能买包括乘客的有备无患。车子内部必须要放香薰，避免因为味道产生投诉，乘客一般都能接受放点音乐或声音，提前告知即可。车内最好禁止抽烟和宠物，这个自己看吧。 4. 关于乘客 我目前接过的乘客也至少有几十人，基本都是友善正常的，没碰到过奇怪的比如喝醉的人。不过尽量和乘客保持距离感，大部分人不喜欢闲聊别去主动搭话，极少部分社牛会主动聊天，陪聊即可，任何过度打听个人信息，套近乎，甚至推销东西的都打马虎眼糊弄过去，别直接怼，可能引发投诉影响接单。 5. 总结 整体性价比偏低，钱少又累属于苦差事，目前我也逐渐跑的少了，但是对于社牛司机来说，也确实能遇到很多有趣的陌生人，也算是一种有趣的人生体验吧

title: The driver was sleepy and asked the passenger to drive the car for him and then charged the full fare. The platform responded.
titleZh: 司机犯困让乘客代开还收全额车费，平台回应
body:
1/4
The driver was sleepy and asked the passenger to drive the car for him and then charged the full fare. The platform responded.
Recently, little girl Zheng from Hangzhou asked the media for help. She said that she and her aunt went to Shanghai to watch Yi-Lian Lam's concert in Shanghai two days ago, and after that, she took a carpooling ride back to Hangzhou. Unexpectedly, the driver said he was sleepy halfway and asked them to drive. In the end, during the two-hour journey, Xiao Zheng's aunt drove for an hour and a half, but the driver fell asleep at the destination and paid the fare in full. Xiao Zheng said that at 10 pm on October 17, after watching Yi Lian Lin's concert in Shanghai, she and her aunt ordered carpooling back to Hangzhou and paid more than 160 yuan for the fare in advance. Less than 5 minutes after picking them up, the driver told them that the car was out of battery and needed to be charged, and he did not set off until after 11 o'clock. Xiao Zheng said that it was too late at the time and they didn't care. Not long after the trip started, the driver said he was sleepy, asked them if they had a driver's license, and asked them to drive. Xiao Zheng said that there was no way to reason on the highway at the time. "Although my aunt had been driving a gas truck, she had just had a gastrointestinal surgery a few days ago, so she had no choice but to take over." The driver originally promised to go to the service area to change people, but ended up sleeping for more than an hour. After getting off the highway, Xiao Zheng's aunt drove to Linping's home. Xiao Zheng's aunt drove about two-thirds of the two-hour journey, and Xiao Zheng still paid the entire fare. When they got off the expressway, they got 68 yuan of highway tolls, and the driver also asked them to pay with their mobile phones. After Xiao Zheng's aunt argued with him, the driver eventually shouldered the cost. After Xiao Zheng returned home, he became more and more angry and complained. At first, the platform only compensated 20 yuan in vouchers. The reporter contacted carpooling customer service, and the other party said that the behavior was a violation of the car owner's rules, and would be punished after confirmation, and a senior service expert would be contacted within 24 hours. Platform rules show that additional charges such as carpooling highway tolls must be negotiated and confirmed before placing an order. It is illegal to temporarily propose charges during the trip, but the driver did not mention it in advance. So far, the platform has refunded the fare in full. (Xiaoqiang Hotline Zhejiang Educational Science)
5 days ago Hunan
bodyZh:
1/4
司机犯困让乘客代开还收全额车费，平台回应
近日，杭州的小郑姑娘求助媒体，她说前两天和姑姑去上海看林忆莲演唱会，结束后在上海叫了一辆顺风车回杭州。没想到，司机半路说自己困了，让她们来开车。最终两个多小时的路程，小郑的姑姑开了一个半小时，司机却睡到了目的地，车费还照单全收。 小郑称，10月17日晚10点，她和姑姑在上海看完林忆莲演唱会后，叫顺风车回杭州，预付160多元车费。司机接到她们不到5分钟，就说车没电要充电，一直充到11点多才出发。 小郑说，当时时间太晚，她们没有计较。结果行程开始没多久，司机又说自己困了，问她们有没有驾照，让她们来开。小郑表示，当时在高速上没法理论，“姑姑虽一直开油车，但刚做完肠胃镜手术没几天，出于无奈只能接手。”司机原本承诺到服务区换人，结果一睡一个多小时，下高速后又由小郑姑姑开到临平家中。两个多小时路程，小郑的姑姑开了约三分之二，车费仍由小郑全程支付。 下高速时产生了68元高速费，司机也让她们掏手机付。小郑的姑姑理论后，司机最终承担了这笔费用。 小郑回家后越想越气后投诉，平台起初只赔20元代金券。记者联系顺风车客服，对方称该行为属车主违规，确认后会处罚，并会上报高级服务专家24小时内联系。平台规则显示，顺风车高速费等额外费用须下单前协商确认，行程中临时提出收费属违规，而司机事先未提及。 截至目前，平台已全额退还车费。（小强热线浙江教科）
5天前 湖南

title: Why can't I pick up other people if I picked up the exclusive ride?
titleZh: 我接了独享为什么不能去接其他人？
body:
1/3
Why can't I pick up other people if I picked up the exclusive ride?
225 kilometers, shared ride 80, exclusive ride 238. I do not bear highway tolls = I accept taking the national highway; if the driver takes the highway, I am willing to bear half of the highway tolls. Considering that there are two cats, we specially took the exclusive ride; both cats were placed in boxes. I asked the driver in advance if he would pick up other people, but the driver pretended to be dead and didn't reply. The appointment was after 2 o'clock, and the driver asked to get on the bus at 1 o'clock, and I agreed. When I got on the bus, I found that there was already one person in the back seat. I endured it and treated it as a relative. I continued to drive around the city and picked up another person, but I endured it again. Then I ran to Jintang to pick up the third person. I couldn't bear it anymore. I asked the driver if I didn't take an exclusive ride. The driver said no matter what, he had to pick up other people. I asked him to take me back, but he refused. Then I asked him to drop me off. I was in Jintang and called the police. I complained to the platform and the platform refunded the money to me; however, it was of no use. Instead, it tormented my cat for more than two hours. I took the exclusive ride because I didn’t want it to be too crowded. If you want to fight for people, just one or two people. What does it mean to fight for three people? So what’s the difference between me and the single ride? Is it a bit too much? Am I being taken advantage of? Do I pay for the exclusive ride and take the shared ride? The old woman in the car also kept saying things like "nothing is easy" and "meeting is fate". Am I easy? I spent money on an exclusive ride but it turned out to be a shared ride. It doesn’t hurt my back when I stand and talk.
The price of a combination car here is only 120-150 per person. Don’t say that the price is low, the high-speed rail is only 90. What I paid is much higher than the market price. The follow-up is: the platform is completely biased towards the driver. I was asked to make up for the difference with a taxi coupon, but I refused. I personally will not use Didi carpooling again, and I will also protect others around me; there is no penalty at all for the driver. Everyone who wants to carpool with Didi should be prepared for the possibility of being tricked or pretending to be dead by the platform. I can't even imagine how scary girls would be at night...
There’s no need for the platform’s customer service to call me. I won’t use your platform anymore and I won’t be able to use the coupons. Either refund my cash or block the driver’s account directly.
06-04
bodyZh:
1/3
我接了独享为什么不能去接其他人？
225公里，拼车80，独享238 我不承担高速费=我接受走国道；如果司机走高速，我愿意承担一半高速费。 考虑到有两只猫，所以专门打了独享；两只猫都是放在箱子里。 提前问了司机还接不接其他人，司机装死不回复；预约的是2点过后，司机要求1点上车，我同意了。 上车了发现后排已经有一个了，我忍了，就当是亲友了；在城里继续绕，又接了一个，我又忍了；然后跑到金堂接了第三个人，忍无可忍。问司机我不是打的独享吗，司机说不管，他还要接其他人；我让他把我送回去，他拒绝；然后我让他把我放下来，人在金堂，报警了。 投诉平台，平台把钱退给我了；然而并没有什么用，反而折腾了我的猫两个多小时。 我打独享就是不想太挤，你要拼人，拼一两个也就算了，拼三个是什么意思，那我和拼单有什么区别？是否有点太过分？我是冤大头吗？我花独享的钱坐拼车？ 同车的老太婆还一直在说什么“都不容易”“相遇就是缘分” 我很容易吗？我花了独享的钱结果是拼车，站着说话不腰疼
我们这里组合车一个人也是120—150，不要在说价格低，高铁也才90；我付的钱远远高于市价 后续就是：平台完全偏向司机。要补差我打车优惠券，我拒绝了，我个人不会再用滴滴顺风车，同时也会向周围的人避雷；对司机也是完全没有任何处罚。 各位打滴滴顺风车要做好被坑、平台装死的可能。 都不敢想象，如果是晚上女孩子有多可怕……
平台的客服也不用给我打电话了，我不会再用你们的平台，用不上优惠券了。要不退我现金，要不直接封司机账号

title: It is not recommended for any car owner who is not short of money to take up carpooling.
titleZh: 不建议任何不缺钱的车主接顺风车
body:
It is not recommended for any car owner who is not short of money to take up carpooling.
Because some people today just look like people. [Uh R] I believe every car owner has had the thought of “should I take a carpooling order?”, and so did I, and I even tried it. When I received the third order, I was so scared that I immediately logged out of the car owner and uninstalled the software. The first two orders I took were from two female students. One order when they went home during the Mid-Autumn Festival, and one order when they came back to work. Both of them were very easy to communicate with and both rides were exclusive, but I still felt unhappy taking the order. Because of the holiday, the traffic jam on the way to pick up and drop off and at the school entrance was particularly serious, but this did not completely eliminate the idea of ​​taking orders. The last one made me give up carpooling completely. I went home during the National Day holiday and took an order. This is a joint order. The destination is more than ten kilometers away from my home, but I am more familiar with the road there, so after thinking about it, I took it. I didn't plan to join the order. After arriving at the lady's designated location, the phone could not be reached. After waiting for about 5 minutes, she came with a suitcase (the passenger did not note that she had luggage). After getting on the bus, I sat in the back seat and opened a pack of biscuits. I discussed with her whether I could not eat in the car (I don’t really like people eating in my car). The lady rolled her eyes at me (my subjective assumption) and then said nothing. At this point I thought we were on the same page. When I was driving about 1-2 kilometers, I heard the sound of packages being pulled and chewed from behind, so I pulled over and said, "Sorry, I don't like people eating in my car." I didn't know where I offended this lady. She had a very bad attitude towards me, saying that she was very careful not to drop the food on my car, and that I was surprised that there were food available in the car. She kept saying this. I explained to her that I don’t know what other people are like, but I don’t like people eating in my car. After an argument, the lady still had a bad attitude and said she didn't want to eat and asked me to leave quickly. I thought I was civilized and polite throughout the entire exchange, but I was also very angry inside and said, "Sorry, I'm very angry now, please get out of the car." On the way home, this lady called me more than twenty times. I only answered the first one because she said on the phone, "If you don't take me home, you won't make it easy for me, and I won't make it easy for you." Halfway through, I was so scared that I uninstalled the app and blocked my phone number, for fear that she would locate my home and take revenge on me. When I came back the next day, I logged out of the car owner and uninstalled it again. It was very scary.
I will never do carpooling on any software again. (I am even writing this post in fear that she will see it and retaliate against me.)
Edited on 10-17 Hebei
bodyZh:
不建议任何不缺钱的车主接顺风车
因为现在的有些人只是看起来像人而已。[呃R] 我相信每一个车主都有过“要不要接一单顺风车”这个念头，我也是，而且我还尝试了，在接到第三单的时候吓得我立刻注销了车主，卸载了软件。 我接的前两单是两位女学生，中秋节回家一单，回来上班一单。两位都很好沟通，也都是独享，但是我仍然觉得接单不开心。因为假期的缘故，接送的路上和学校的门口堵车特别严重，但这并没有彻底消灭我接单的念头。 最后一位让我彻底放弃了接顺风车。国庆放假回家接了一单，这位是拼单，目的地离我家十几公里，但我比较熟悉那边的路，想了想还是接了，我没打算拼人。 到了这位女士的指定地点之后，电话打不通，等了5min左右，她带着一个行李箱来了（乘客并未备注有行李）。 上车后坐在后排打开一包饼干，我与其商量可以不可以不在车上吃东西（我本人不太喜欢有人在我车上吃东西），这位女士白了我一眼（我主观臆断），然后一言不发。这时我以为我们达成了一致。 在开出去大概1-2公里的时候，我听到后面有包装扯动声以及咀嚼声，于是我靠边停下说：“不好意思，我不太喜欢有人在我车上吃东西。”我不知道自己哪里惹到了这位女士，她对我的态度非常恶劣，说自己吃的很小心没有掉到我的车上，说就我很奇怪车上都是可以吃东西的之类的，反复说。我跟她解释别人怎么样我不知道，但是我不喜欢有人在我车上吃东西。争执一番之后这位女士态度还是很差的说自己不吃了，让我赶紧走。 我自认为自己整个交流过程中均文明礼貌，但是内心也很生气说：“不好意思，我现在也很生气，麻烦你下车。” 回家的路上这位女士给我打了二十多个电话。我只接了第一个，因为她在电话里说“你不拉我回家，你不让我好过，我也不让你好过。” 半路上吓得我直接把app卸载了，电话号码拉黑，生怕她定位到我家报复我。第二天下回来直接注销了车主，再卸载，很吓人了。
再也不会在任何软件上接顺风车了。（我甚至写这篇帖子都在害怕她看到，然后报复我。）
编辑于 10-17 河北

title: Disgusted by professional carpooling passengers 🤢
titleZh: 被职业顺风车乘客恶心了🤢
body:
1/7
Disgusted by professional carpooling passengers 🤢
The reason is that I have to send my younger brother back to school today (Shanghai to Suzhou), so I went to Hello last night to see if I could pick up a carpooling order and share the highway tolls and gas expenses. When I posted the itinerary, I had already chosen the number of seats available to be 3, which means that there is a relative or friend traveling with me in the car. Before leaving today, I planned to call this person to confirm the departure time and the fact that my brother was traveling with me in the car. That’s when things started to go wrong. I called her 4 times in a row before setting off and all hung up within seconds. I thought maybe she would have special circumstances and it was inconvenient to answer the phone, so I set off first. Halfway through, I glanced at my phone and saw her sending me a question mark❓ and I felt very uncomfortable. My brother also said that this person was so unqualified, but I thought I was almost at her starting point. After picking up someone, the first thing she said when she got in the car was, "Didn't I take an exclusive ride? Why is there someone else?" I explained to her that this was my younger brother and I was sending him to school. Later I asked her why she didn't answer the phone, and she replied that she didn't like to answer other people's calls. . . (Why are you taking a taxi if you don’t answer the phone? May I ask😅) I was still chatting with my brother on the way, talking and laughing the whole time. A normal person can tell that we are very close to each other. It is impossible for us to be strangers we don’t know, so there is no situation where I am taking orders on other platforms. After getting off the highway, I told her highway tolls29 and asked her to pay on the platform. After she got off the bus, I found that highway tolls had not been paid yet, so I sent her a message and found out that she had been blocked! ! ! At that time, I realized that I might have met a professional passenger, but 20 minutes later she paid for the highway tolls again. I thought that maybe she simply forgot. After returning home in the afternoon, I suddenly received a text message saying that I had been complained about paying extra people. At this time, I finally realized why she didn't answer other people's calls. Most likely, she did such immoral things too many times and was scolded by others on the phone, so she didn't dare to answer calls from strangers. Fortunately, this was the first time I was complained, so the platform only deducted a moderate 50 growth points, otherwise I would have to give her the highway tolls to refund the car.
I used to think that I would never encounter a professional passenger. After all, I don’t do much carpooling. I didn’t expect that I would encounter a professional passenger just after I took the 6th order. It’s not about luck.
The good mood of the day was ruined like this

1/7

以前以为职业乘客我肯定碰不上，毕竟我也不怎么接顺风车，没想到这才接第6单就让我碰到了，运气这块没的说

title: There are still people who think there is real carpooling!
titleZh: 现在居然还有人认为有真顺风车！
body:
There are still people who think there is real carpooling!
After reading a lot of notes in Xiaohongshu, many passengers were complaining about why highway tolls should be included, and why this package should be included. Now it can basically be said that 99% of the time it is professional carpooling. You can just think of it as the old black cars. They are driven by professional black car drivers, and they are meant to make money. The current carpooling chaos is either asking you for more money, charging you highway tolls, or charging you more on holidays; there is another kind of carpooling that is really disgusting, that is, you have obviously booked an exclusive ride, and they turn around and go to other platforms to recruit a few people. This is really not authentic. But I think the bottom line for these black cars is that as long as the price is negotiated with you at the beginning and they don’t turn their backs on you and force you to pay extra, it’s actually fine. Nowadays, there is very little carpooling in the true sense, that is, the driver himself does not rely on this to make a living, but just picks up one or two people along the way to return some gas money and share some highway tolls. Just treat it as a black car. If you are looking for a carpooling car that is new, comfortable, cheap and does not require highway tolls, there is basically none. There are two main reasons: First, people who drive such good cars don’t lack the money. Now the platform fees are too low, right? What's the second one? The car owner has no way to screen high-quality passengers. Some passengers feel unbalanced when they see you driving a nice car worth hundreds of thousands of dollars, so they deliberately scratch your car with their nails. You couldn't tell it at the time, but it was a good intention. Maybe you are simple, and you will only know it after you have suffered a loss. Therefore, many people are reluctant to use their cars for carpooling, especially new cars that cost RMB 300,000 to RMB 400,000 to RMB 400,000 to RMB 400,000. If you look at the shabby cars on the road, they are basically driven by professionals, and there is no real carpooling at all. So please stop posting and complaining about carpooling charging highway tolls and charging extra money. Those are basically black cars and they are all professional.
10-03 Jiangsu
bodyZh:
现在居然还有人认为有真顺风车！
在小红书看了好多笔记，好多乘客都在抱怨，又是什么要包高速费，又是什么包这包那的。 现在基本上可以这么说，99% 的情况下都是职业顺风车，你直接把它理解成以前的黑车就行了，都是职业开黑车的人在开，本来就是要赚钱的。 现在的顺风车乱象，要么是找你要更多钱、收你高速费，或者节假日多收一点；还有一种确实挺恶心的，就是你明明打了独享，他转头又去其他平台拉几个人，这一点确实不地道。 但我觉得这些黑车的底线，只要一开始把价格跟你谈妥了，中途没有翻脸不认人把你扔下、逼你额外加钱，其实都还好。 现在很少很少有真正意义上的顺风车了，也就是那种司机本身不靠这个营生，只是顺路拉一两个人回点油钱、分摊点高速费的。大家直接把它当成黑车来看就行。 你想找那种新车子、坐得舒服、价格便宜又不要高速费的顺风车，基本上没有。 原因主要有两个： 第一，开这种好车的人他不缺那点钱，现在平台费用太低了，对吧？ 第二个是什么？车主没办法筛选高质量的乘客。有些乘客看你开几十万的好车，他心里不平衡，就拿指甲故意划你车子。你当时看不出来，本是一番好意，可能你人单纯，只有吃过一次亏你才知道。所以很多人都舍不得把自己车拿出来当顺风车，特别是那种三四十万、四五十万的新车，人家真舍不得。 你看路上那种破破的车子，基本上都是职业跑的，根本没有真正意义上的顺风车了。所以大家别再老发帖吐槽说什么顺风车又是收高速费、又是额外加钱，那些基本都是黑车，都是职业的。
10-03 江苏

comments.text: I figured it out after taking the train three times. I didn’t take the tram more than 500 times. The rest were really smooth rides. Real SF trains are very clean and taste good.

comments.text: At least 99% plus high speed included

comments.text: Me. I post a trip when I drive home from work, but only accept a 100% route match. Last time someone who would require a two-kilometer detour messaged asking why I wouldn't accept them. I just said I wasn't making that detour.
comments.zh: 我啊，我下班回家就会发个单但是只接百分百顺路，上次一个需要绕路两公里的还私信我为啥不接他，我直接说还得绕两公里不去

title: Carpooling is ruined by “professional carpooling”
titleZh: 顺风车毁于“职业顺风车”
body:
1/3
Carpooling is ruined by “professional carpooling”
08-12
bodyZh:
1/3
顺风车毁于“职业顺风车”
08-12

comments.text: Reply: But I always pick up people coming from and to get off work. If I really want to take the expressway, I will ask for highway tolls. If you don’t want to give them, I have already got in the car and have nothing to say. I will go out on my own and I won’t pick up this person anymore.
comments.zh: 回复碎辞 : 不过我都是接上下班的，遇到真要走高速会提高速费的事情不愿意给的话，都已经上车没话说了就我自己出呗以后不接这个人了

comments.text: It’s much cheaper for passengers, okay. I used to go back to the city from get off work for 25 bucks. Then it was 20, then 15, and finally 12. I just watched the price get more and more outrageous. In the end, after I laughed a few times over the 12-yuan order, I deleted the app and never looked at it again. Who is so poor for 12 yuan? Not up to my starting price of driving the door for others.
comments.zh: 乘客便宜多了好吧。我以前下班回市区 25 块。后来就 20，然后 15，到最终 12。我就看着这价格越来越扯。最后我笑了几次 12 块的订单后，app 删了再也没看。12 块谁这么穷。达不到我为他人开车门的起步价

comments.text: Very much agree. The large number of fake carpooling drivers coming online is actually the result of three loses: real carpooling drivers can't take orders (taking orders more casually); passengers have to pay more (they need to pay highway tolls); and fake carpooling drivers have intensified competition and their fees are getting lower and lower. Five years ago, 80 kilometers was less than 70 yuan, but now 100 kilometers is only 65 yuan. As a passenger, I am embarrassed to pay such a low price, and I have to add 5 to 10 yuan as a thank you fee. But as a passenger, the cost itself is increased because you don’t have to pay highway fees before, and you can share industry gossip with the driver throughout the journey. But now you have to pay an additional thirty or forty yuan for highway tolls, and there is basically no communication with the driver. I feel that the only beneficiary is the platform, because with more orders, their commissions will also increase.
comments.zh: 非常赞同。大量伪顺风车司机上线其实是三输的结果，真顺风车司机接不到单子（接单比较随性）；乘客增加费用（需要支付高速费）；伪顺风车司机竞争加剧，费用越来越低。5年前，80公里大约不到70元，现在100公里竟然只要65元，我作为乘客都不好意思给这么低的价，要加5到10元的感谢费。但作为乘客，本身的成本是增加的，因为之前不用付高速，而且全程可以和司机分享行业八卦。而现在则需要支付额外的三四十元的高速费，而且与司机基本无交流。我感觉唯一的受益方是平台，因为单子多了，它们的抽成也多了。

comments.text: Reply to the porter: Highway tolls are not given to real passengers, and they are not picked up if they like.
comments.zh: 回复搬运工 : 真乘客不给高速费，爱接不接

comments.text: It’s less than 60 yuan for 100 kilometers here.
comments.zh: 我这里100公里不到60元

comments.text: Reply to fragmentary remarks: Because the time cost is indeed there, it is spread a little, but not much.
comments.zh: 回复碎辞 : 因为时间成本确实在那里，有摊一些，但是不多

comments.text: Yes, I won’t answer it now
comments.zh: 对啊，我现在都不接了

comments.text: Reply to the porter: What does a car owner really want highway tolls for? We all depend on how smooth the road is. The kind that is more or less smooth. Anyway, if you bring one, you will make a pure profit. If you don’t bring it, I have to go.
comments.zh: 回复搬运工 : 真车主要高速费做啥，我们都是看顺路程度，要点到点顺的那种，反正带一个就是纯赚，不带我也得走啊

comments.text: The fuel cost of a car is 60 cents per kilometer, but it can be even lower on the expressway, 40 to 50 cents. 65 yuan for 100 kilometers is indeed the purpose of the platform to share fuel costs. What's more, there are a large number of trams now, and one kilometer only costs a few cents. You may think you are losing money, but in fact, the tram car owner still makes money.
comments.zh: 小轿车一公里六毛的油费，上高速能更低，四五毛。100公里65元确实就是平台卡着分摊油费的目的。更何况现在大量的电车，一公里才几分钱，你以为你亏了，其实电车车主还有得赚。

comments.text: The person who replied: I saw that many of them are 95%. If there is no one on the way, just drive by yourself. Anyway, the carpooling owner should have gone to that place, just to save some costs, not to make money, and there is no need to spend time to pick up and drop off. If there is more than 95%, then pick up, otherwise just go by yourself. Just like when I go carpooling, if someone picks me up, I leave. If no one picks me up, I just take an express bus.
comments.zh: 回复之乎者也 : 我看到很多都是95%，如果没有顺路的就自己开呗，反正顺风车主应该是本来也要去那个地方，就为了省点成本，而不是赚钱，也没必要花时间去接送，就有95%以上再接，不然就自己去就行了。就像我打顺风车，有人接就走，没人接我就直接打快车一样。

comments.text: The impact on real car owners is almost zero
comments.zh: 对真车主影响几乎为零

comments.text: In fact, the unit price has not been reduced, because in the past, there was basically no such thing as expressway collection, and in the past, car owners basically put in one order, or at most two orders, but now they both charge expressway and fill it up.
comments.zh: 单价其实也没降低，因为原先基本没有收高速这个事，而且原先车主基本拼一单，最多就是两单，现在都是既收高速的话又拼满。

comments.text: It only costs 30 to 40 yuan for 100 kilometers, and the one I took for 700 to 800 kilometers was less than 300 yuan.

comments.zh: 回复小红薯66037A6E : 真车主也要你高速费，爱走不走

comments.zh: 回复碎辞 : 感觉应该取缔职业好一点，不然真车主实在不想拼单

comments.zh: 回复momo : 平台提供信息，这也没办法，信息就是最大的资源

comments.zh: 回复三木成森 : 网约车平台早已开始收割顺风车的韭菜了！

comments.zh: 我以前接的第一单就是三个女学生。跑300公里高速听她们在车上叽叽喳喳的挺好玩

Occasionally, I will say a few words at the end to prevent myself from looking too much like a professional driver. After all, he is a grown man with a family and a family, and it is a bit strange that the carpooling girls are talking to him.
comments.zh: 和乘客交流就算了，一般乘客不主动说话我都不轻易搭话，偶尔最后到终点了说上一两句避免自己太像职业司机，毕竟有家有口的大男人，打顺风车的都是小姐姐搭话多少有点怪怪的

comments.text: Every time I hear carpooling car owners say "it doesn't make money", I find it unbelievable. Carpooling is not used to make money at all.
comments.zh: 我每次听到顺风车车主说“不赚钱”，我都感到匪夷所思，顺风车根本就不是用来赚钱的

comments.text: I genuinely need these trips and travel between Guangzhou, Dongguan and Shenzhen all year round. I always use carpooling, but only two or three trips a year are with genuine carpool drivers. The rest are full-time drivers using automatic order grabbing. Full-time drivers work well for me too: pickups and drop-offs are quick. Driving myself takes energy and money, and parking in Guangzhou and Shenzhen is expensive and hard to find.
comments.zh: 我是出行刚需，常年广州东莞深圳跑，每次都是顺风车，一年到头也就两三次真顺风车，其余都是职业顺风车，且他们抢单都是自动的。对于我来说职业也挺好，能快速接送。自己开车费神费钱。广州深圳的停车位不好找且贵.

comments.text: Agreed. Lots of comments blame habitual bargain-hunting passengers, but the reality is that the influx of full-time carpool drivers intensified competition, letting platforms cut prices at will. That then attracted more of those passengers. Before there were many full-time drivers, long-distance rates could reach 1.2 yuan per kilometer, and passengers were generally more considerate too.
comments.zh: 赞同，评论还有很多说毁于职业乘客，但事实就是职业车主多了导致内卷严重，平台才会随意降价，最后导致职业乘客多起来。以前没啥职业司机的时候，远距离单价能到1.2，乘客的综合素质也比现在高

comments.zh: 没有职业司机长途真的很难有人接，600多公里的拼单价也就100多块钱，很难有那么顺路的了

comments.text: That's not entirely true. Without full-time carpool drivers, there might be no rides available. Personally, I only take bookings that are extremely well matched to my route and exclusive. Really, the platform is to blame: it should use vehicle registration details to limit drivers to two or three bookings a day, preventing full-time drivers from accepting bookings indiscriminately.
comments.zh: 也不完全是吧，如果没有职业顺风车的话那将无顺风车可坐。比如说我，我直接超级超级顺路，下独享的，其实要怪平台，平台应该限制，按照行驶证信息，一天只能接2-3单，这样就可以避免职业顺风车乱接单了。

title: The cat I had raised for eight years was stuffed into the trunk by the driver and suffocated to death
titleZh: 我养了八年的猫，被司机塞进后备箱活活闷死
body:
1/11
The cat I had raised for eight years was stuffed into the trunk by the driver and suffocated to death
“The cat I had for eight years was stuffed into the trunk by the driver and suffocated to death”: Who cares whether carpooling is an “exclusive ride” or not? This is a true story and an absurd drama that is being played out repeatedly among countless carpooling passengers. On one side, there is an aunt who has lost her "little kid" who has been with her for eight years. She cries until she collapses, but the driver blocks the ride and runs away without any punishment. On the other side, there are thousands of passengers who place orders for "exclusive rides", but the driver inserts strangers into them on various platforms, causing detours, late arrivals, and crowded spaces. These two incidents seem to occur in the same place, but in fact they are rooted in the same problem: when carpooling drivers turn "fake rides" into business, who will pay for the consequences? What happened to my aunt sounds extreme. But if you often carpool, you must have encountered the following scenarios: · You place an order for an "exclusive ride", and when you get in the car, you find that the passenger seat and the back seat are full of people · The driver is driving with three or four mobile phones on the center console, and various platforms are taking orders at the same time · In order to pick up the "next customer", the driver takes a detour for half an hour or an hour, and you are anxious to catch a plane or a train · You question why the driver wants to share the "exclusive ride" ride, the other party said confidently: "What will I earn if I don't share the ride?" This is not an exception, this is a common phenomenon. According to the relevant provisions of the Civil Code, the aunt can claim compensation from the driver for: (1) The market value of the cat (purchase cost) (2) Solatium for mental damage (high cost of proof, Article 1183 of the Civil Code) (3) Full refund of shipping costs. Just because the driver blackmails the cat and runs away does not mean that the legal liability disappears. If the license plate number is there, people can find it. The police can check the identity of the car owner through the license plate, and the traffic law enforcement department can trace the order record. Platforms are also obliged to disclose true information about drivers. Finally, what kind of travel environment do we want? Auntie’s cat can’t come back. It is difficult to fully compensate for the delayed schedule, occupied space, and consumed trust. But the issues exposed by this incident are far more worthy of attention than the death of a cat: when carpooling drivers can turn "exclusive rides" into shared rides at no cost, when platforms only use a few yuan to pay off injured passengers, when blacklisting and running away can evade all responsibility - the travel safety of each of us is being eroded little by little. We hope that: · Platforms will establish a true stepped compensation mechanism (refund the price difference + 3-5 times compensation) · Each platform will establish a driver blacklist linkage mechanism. If a violation occurs on one platform, all platforms will be banned. · The traffic law enforcement department will increase its crackdown on "fake carpooling" to make illegal operations truly "heartbreaking". · The law will give more respect to the emotional value of pets that accompany them for a long time. Auntie is still sad. The driver is still at large. But we don’t want you, or someone you love, to be the next victim.
Edited on 05-23
bodyZh:
1/11
我养了八年的猫，被司机塞进后备箱活活闷死
“我养了八年的猫，被司机塞进后备箱活活闷死了”：顺风车“独享”不独享，到底谁来管？ 这是一个真实的故事，也是一个正在无数顺风车乘客身上反复上演的荒诞剧。 一边，是一位阿姨失去陪伴八年的“毛孩子”，哭到崩溃，司机却拉黑跑路，至今未受任何惩罚； 另一边，是成千上万的乘客下单“独享”，却被司机在各个平台塞进陌生人，绕路、迟到、空间拥挤。 这两件事，看似一个天一个地，实则根源于同一个问题：当顺风车司机把“假顺路”做成了生意，谁来为后果买单？ 阿姨的遭遇，听起来极端。但如果你经常打顺风车，你一定遇到过下面这些场景： · 你下单“独享”，上车后发现副驾驶、后座全坐满了人 · 司机一边开车，一边在中控台上架着三四部手机，各个平台同时接单 · 为了接“下一个客人”，司机绕路半小时、一小时，你赶飞机、赶火车的心急如焚 · 你质疑司机为什么“独享”还要拼车，对方理直气壮：“不拼车我赚什么？” 这不是个例，这是普遍现象。 根据《民法典》相关规定，阿姨可以主张司机赔偿的是： （1）猫的市场价值（购买费用） （2）精神损害抚慰金（证明成本高，民法典1183条） （3）运费全额退还 司机拉黑跑路，不等于法律责任消失。 车牌号在，人就能找到。警方可以通过车牌查询车主身份，交通执法部门可以追溯其接单记录。平台也有义务披露司机的真实信息。 最后，我们想要一个什么样的出行环境？ 阿姨的猫回不来了。 那些被耽误的行程、被挤占的空间、被消耗的信任，也很难完全补偿。 但这起事件暴露的问题，远比一只猫的死亡更值得关注： 当顺风车司机可以毫无成本地把“独享”变成拼车，当平台只用几块钱打发受害乘客，当拉黑跑路就能逃避一切责任——我们每个人的出行安全，都在被一点点蚕食。 我们希望： · 平台建立真正的阶梯式赔偿机制（退还差价+3-5倍赔偿） · 各平台建立司机黑名单联动机制，在一个平台违规，所有平台禁入 · 交通执法部门加大对“假顺风车”的打击力度，让非法营运真正“肉疼” · 法律上对长期陪伴宠物的情感价值给予更多尊重 阿姨还在伤心。司机还在逍遥。 但我们不希望下一个受害者，是你，或者你爱的人事物。
编辑于 05-23

title: If you are a male traveling alone, you can cancel without obligation.
titleZh: 男性单独乘车您可以无责取消
body:
If you are a male traveling alone, you can cancel without obligation.
I set my Didi carpooling preference to give priority to female drivers. When I got to the car this morning, I looked through the open passenger window and saw a row of cute pink decorations. When I opened the back door, it was just as I imagined, with clean floor mats, flat seat cushions, a refreshing fragrance, and a gentle smile. Before I even closed the car door, the eldest sister said before she could lower her lips: "Have you set the priority for female drivers?" I couldn't wait to respond to her: "Yes, can you see it over there?" "Haha, the platform notified me as soon as I received the order. This is a female-friendly order. If a man is traveling alone, I can cancel without any responsibility." Through the rearview mirror, we saw clearly the slightly raised corners of each other's mouths. I said "It's great", and the eldest sister also said "It's great". We didn't go into details about what was great about it, we were all in the smiles we exchanged in the air with the fragrance as the medium. She is clean and neat Ms. Wang, Ms. Wang with short hair, Ms. Wang who has a daughter born in 2006, Ms. Wang with a gentle smile, Ms. Wang who takes 10,000+ orders and is defined as an "urban hero" by the platform, and Ms. Wang with superb driving skills who helped me not be late. I am Ms. Guan, who is used to wearing a mask on ride-hailing but does not need it for this order. Together with her eldest sister and daughter, she collectively calls her the post-00s Ms. Guan. My eldest sister commented that she looks like a new teacher. Ms. Guan, who went to the meeting with only half makeup on because she slept in. Ms. Guan, who was not late for the meeting with the help of her eldest sister. In today's unexpected encounter, we all felt the small blessing of being "female friendly".
Edited on 04-18

编辑于 04-18

title: Didi carpooling private shared ride deduction｜Customer service refused to review
titleZh: 滴滴顺风车私下拼车扣费｜客服拒绝复核
body:
1/7
Didi carpooling private shared ride deduction｜Customer service refused to review
"This trick of Didi is too malicious. It has become lawless and it can be done as it pleases. Didi carpooling car owner has stepped on a big trap. The order was a clear exclusive ride order, and only one passenger was picked up during the whole journey. No one was picked up privately, no detours, no extra passengers. The system AI directly judged that I shared the ride privately, and directly deducted a penalty. I appealed to the official customer service, and after many communications, the reply I got was one sentence: There is no way to solve it, and I cannot escalate the feedback to superiors. Regardless of whether I offered to verify the GPS track, the chat history in the app, or even contact the passenger for verification, the customer service refused directly and only offered excuses. What’s even more terrible is that the passenger who agreed to the highway tolls in advance did not pay in the end, and the platform still deducted my money. The job number is 203047, and the entire chat record is retained. The original purpose of the exclusive ride order is to only pull one person, and the algorithm is rough and the appeal channel is useless. Does the owner have no room for appeal? Are there any car owners who were also misjudged by Didi carpooling for illegal deductions? How did everyone successfully defend their rights in the end?
17 hours ago Tianjin

1/7
滴滴顺风车私下拼车扣费｜客服拒绝复核

title: What is carpooling?
titleZh: 什么是顺风车？
body:
What is carpooling?
Is it carpooling that requires me to pay the driver to travel to and from highway tolls? Is it carpooling where the driver has to go around an extra 200 kilometers and I have to pay the extra fare outside the route? The driver himself said that no one called me back when I called him. Is this carpooling?

comments.zh: 我经常都是空车都不接，就算邀请不合理大部分也不接，不能便宜了职业乘客

comments.text: There may even be a price increase. I took a taxi from Jingdezhen a few days ago, and the fare was only over 60. Two drivers in a row asked for an increase, and the extra charge was 60. They also asked me to pay extra highway tolls. I chose to split the fare equally with the driver. Can't he see that? He didn't pay a dime, and he was really convinced. And you won’t leave without increasing the price, just double the price.
comments.zh: 甚至还要加价。我景德镇前几天打，车费才60多，连续两个司机都要求加价，一加就是六十，还要我再额外付高速费，我选的我和司机平摊车费，他看不到吗？他一毛不掏，真服了。而且不加价不走，直接双倍

comments.text: I have encountered an exclusive ride that required ➕30 yuan and highway tolls.
comments.zh: 我遇到过独享要求➕30元且出高速费的。

comments.text: When I pick up carpooling passengers, I never ask passengers to leave highway tolls, but I will never accept orders from a distance of more than 3 kilometers (for long distances, 10 kilometers).
comments.zh: 我接顺风车从不要乘客出高速费，但是接送距离3公里以外的单子绝对不接（长途的话10公里吧）

comments.text: Similarly, a few days ago I stung a hornet's nest. The drivers of illegal cars were very speechless. After scolding you, they blocked you immediately, leaving you unable to reply. I complained about someone who said bad words, and the Xiaohongshu platform actually took care of it.
comments.zh: 一样的，前几天捅了马蜂窝了，那些黑车司机很无语，骂完你之后立马拉黑，让你回复不了。我投诉了一个说脏话的，小红书平台还真处理了。

comments.text: Bloggers can try calling on Dida. I often meet Xiangxiang female drivers on Dida! They are all real carpooling masters who have not taken a few orders. Don’t look for those who take a lot of orders. They are all professional and make money.
comments.zh: 博主可以试试去嘀嗒上叫，我在嘀嗒上经常遇到香香的女司机！都是真顺风车主，没接过几单的，你不要找那种接单次数特别多的，都是职业赚钱的

comments.text: Reply to Honghong: Me too. Later, the third driver who took the order didn’t say a fare increase, but asked to take the expressway and I paid for the entire expressway, so I paid and left quickly [crying with laughter R]
comments.zh: 回复红红 : 我也是，后来第三个接单的司机没说加价，但是要求走高速并且我付全程高速，我就付了赶紧走吧[笑哭了R]

comments.text: How many real car owners are there? They are all shady car drivers.
comments.zh: 哪有几个真车主在跑全是黑车司机

comments.text: No one really thinks that carpooling is 100% convenient, right?
comments.zh: 不会真有人以为顺风车是100%顺路吧

comments.text: Stop talking about the carpooling culture. We really need to rectify the professional carpooling that is all about low prices.
comments.zh: 别说了顺风车的风气真要整顿了全是➕价的职业顺风车

comments.text: Most of them are fake carpooling, so I don’t take them anymore. For distant high-speed trains, the drivers of illegal cars are more reliable than the full-time drivers of carpooling.
comments.zh: 绝大多数都是假顺风车，所以我不坐了，远的自己开车近的高铁，黑车司机都比顺风车的专职司机靠谱

comments.text: There is no 100% smooth ride, it always takes about half an hour to pick up and drop off.
comments.zh: 哪有100%的顺路，都是要花半小时左右接和送的

comments.text: Highway tolls asked me for 5 yuan and asked me for 15 yuan to tell me about the gas bill. My platform also paid more than 30 yuan.
comments.zh: 5块钱高速费找我要15说油费怎么样，，我平台还付了三十多

comments.text: Indeed, it’s really annoying
comments.zh: 确实，真的很烦了

comments.text: I do all the exclusive rides, and I also ride all the highway tolls. . .
comments.zh: 我都是独享 然后高速费也是我全出。。。

comments.text: If there are no illegal drivers, just take the bus.
comments.zh: 没有黑车司机 就老老实实坐大巴

comments.text: Reply to Yu You Niannian: I agree with the driver before I get on the bus that if I pay for half of the highway tolls, then he can take at most one person to take out the other half. If he wants to bring more people, then don’t take my order. If he can’t stand the crowding, he will pay more and waste time. The two-way option is agreed in advance.
comments.zh: 回复余有年年年 : 我现在上车前和司机先说好，我出一半高速费，那他最多再带一个人出另一半，如果他要带人多带满，那就不要接我的单了，受不了挤满了还要多出钱多浪费时间的，双向选择提前说好

comments.text: If it doesn’t go well, you don’t have to accept it.
comments.zh: 不顺可以不接

comments.text: Finally, someone with an experience as outrageous as mine. Mine was 260 including tolls, but they wanted me to pay 600.
comments.zh: 终于看到和我一样离谱的了。我的算上高速费260，要我出600

comments.text: Why?
comments.zh: 为什么啊

comments.text: What I don't understand is whether carpool bookings are assigned to drivers compulsorily by the platform. I tried booking once, thinking it was fine if nobody accepted. But a driver accepted and then called to yell at me.
comments.zh: 我不理解的是，顺风车的单是平台强制派单吗？我之前试了一下，想着没人接就算了，结果司机接单之后打电话过来骂我一顿

comments.text: I split the tolls too, but with four people and a 23-yuan toll, they charged the two of us 20. Unbelievable.
comments.zh: 我也是平摊，但是4个人23的高速费，我两个人收20我真服了

comments.text: I suddenly feel incredibly lucky. My first carpool trip was 800 kilometers with just me and my cat. I booked a shared ride, but the driver said he couldn't be bothered picking up anyone else, so I had the car to myself. He didn't charge tolls either, just 327 yuan. Bless that kind man!
comments.zh: 突然觉得我运气超好，我第一次打顺风车，一人一猫800公里，我打的还是拼车，结果大哥说他懒得接别人了，就接了我一个，也没要我高速费，就收了我327，大哥好人一生平安！

comments.text: Is 300 yuan enough for a 200-kilometer ride?
comments.zh: 200公里打车300够吗？

title: The carpooling driver was too sleepy and asked the passenger to drive, but the 160 yuan fare was still collected
titleZh: 顺风车司机太困让乘客开车，160元车费照收
body:
00:02 / 00:35
The carpooling driver was too sleepy and asked the passenger to drive, but the 160 yuan fare was still collected
Yesterday 03:05 Guangdong
bodyZh:
00:02 / 00:35
顺风车司机太困让乘客开车，160元车费照收
昨天 03:05 广东

comments.text: At least eliminate highway tolls, otherwise people won’t complain.
comments.zh: 至少把高速费免了吧，不然人家也不会投诉

comments.text: You give him the carpooling fee, or you ask him to pay you the driving fee, and you can still charge a little bit.
comments.zh: 你把顺风车费给他，喊他给你代驾费各算各的，你还能收一点

comments.text: It's really scary. I saw a passenger slapped the driver and woke him up. But that was a regular operating vehicle, not a carpooling one.
comments.zh: 真吓人 我看有乘客打司机巴掌把司机打醒的 不过那是普通运营车不是顺风车

comments.text: He is too sleepy, and the fare may not be refunded. It would be more dangerous for him to drive.
comments.zh: 他太困了，可能车费也不退，非得他开更危险

comments.text: There are two-way options on the platform. You can pay by yourself, or negotiate with the driver. Nowadays, it is usually an equal share when taking the expressway, but there are also some unscrupulous people who ask passengers to pay entirely. Exclusive ride changes the order and says it will save you some highway tolls.
comments.zh: 平台上有双向选择，自己付，或者和司机协商，现在走高速一般是平摊，但是也有黑心全让乘客付。独享改拼单然后说给你省点高速费。

comments.text: In fact, it is also a loophole. Carpooling’s audit fee is lower than that of ride-hailing. The unit price of carpooling is lower than that of ride-hailing. From a safety perspective, carpooling is not very good.
comments.zh: 其实也是钻空子，顺风车审核松抽成也比网约车低一些，顺风车的单价又比网约车的低，从安全性来说顺风车不太行

comments.text: In the future, you can follow this idea when looking for a driver. Not only do you not have to pay, but you will also earn 160.
comments.zh: 以后找代驾就按这个思路好了，不仅不用给钱，还倒赚160。

comments.text: Not only that, but also his 50r expressway discount coupon
comments.zh: 不止，还是他高速50r抵扣券

comments.text: I drive the car, pay the fare, and pay for the highway. I wouldn’t want to change it for me. It would be better to waive the highway tolls or charge half the fare.
comments.zh: 车我开，车费我照付，高速也出大头，换我我也不愿意啊，免了高速费或者收一半车费也好一点啊

comments.text: Everyone should calculate it separately. The fare is the fare, and the driving fee should also be charged.
comments.zh: 应该各算各的，车费归车费，代驾费也要收一下

comments.text: It's like he found a driver who paid for him.
comments.zh: 等于他找了个倒贴钱的代驾啊

comments.text: Your husband is in a good mood. He is in a good mood and everything goes well.
comments.zh: 你老公心态好好～心态好诸事顺

comments.text: At least we don’t insist on safety being the first priority.
comments.zh: 至少没有硬撑安全第一

comments.text: It’s just that you shouldn’t take orders when you’re sleepy.
comments.zh: 就是困的时候就不该接单

comments.text: My brother was carpooling, and the driver said he was sleepy. When my brother drove back, they reduced the toll from 55 yuan to 25 yuan. My brother came back so beautiful that he kept talking about it.
comments.zh: 我弟弟打顺风车，司机说困，我弟开回来了，人家把路费55减到了25块，把我弟美的回来一直说

comments.text: Then the driver in the back seat probably has to pay for the ride.
comments.zh: 那后座那个司机恐怕得付乘车费吧

comments.text: To be fair, the driver should have paid the driving fee. And what if the passenger doesn’t have a driver’s license?
comments.zh: 公平的话应该是司机付代驾费了 而且万一乘客没有驾照呢？

comments.text: It’s okay if you don’t say you can’t drive.
comments.zh: 不说不会开车不就行了，

comments.text: My husband returned to Shanghai from Zhoushan before. Yes. It is said that a film producer was filming a movie in Zhoushan and was too sleepy. I also let my husband drive it by himself. My husband drove all the way back to Shanghai. My husband was still very happy and told me that he had driven an Audi.
comments.zh: 我老公之前从舟山回上海。也是的 据说是个电影制片人在舟山拍电影 太困了。也让我老公自己开 我老公一路开回上海 我老公还很开心 跟我说开上奥迪了

comments.text: This is reasonable
comments.zh: 这种才是合理的

comments.text: You're renting a car
comments.zh: 你就当租车了

comments.text: Are you going to put out highway tolls now that the wind is blowing? Never used it before
comments.zh: 你们现在顺风还要出高速费呀？以前都不用的呀

comments.text: Reply to Wild Voldemort: But in this video the victim paid 50 highway tolls
comments.zh: 回复野生伏地魔 : 但是这个视频里事主付了50高速费

comments.text: I like this. I can drive, and I get a free ride home too.
comments.zh: 我喜欢这个，我会开还免费回来了

comments.text: Hiring a designated driver costs much more than the fare.
comments.zh: 代驾可比车费贵多了

comments.text: Carpooling means the driver is going to that destination anyway and finds someone whose route matches. The driver benefits, and the passenger normally pays less than for a dedicated driver.
comments.zh: 顺风车就是司机也要到目的地，找个刚好顺路的，司机获利，乘客给的钱一般比专门拉客的要便宜

comments.text: Reply to 野生伏地魔: No, you have to state beforehand that you won't pay tolls; otherwise you need to pay. You can also negotiate paying half, or take ordinary roads.
comments.zh: 回复野生伏地魔 : 不是啊，要提前备注不出高速费，不然要出的，也可以沟通出一半，或者走国道

comments.text: I've experienced that too. It was especially scary at night, but I couldn't drive, so he pushed through and finished the trip.
comments.zh: 我也经历过。。晚上特别吓人，但是我不会开车，他硬撑着开完的

comments.text: Yes, I think waiving the tolls would roughly make it fair, and most people wouldn't complain then. If you're driving, paying tolls and paying the fare too, of course you'd feel it was unfair.
comments.zh: 是的，我感觉高速费免了就差不多了，一般也不会投诉了，又开车又付高速又付车费，心里肯定不平衡了
